tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po sgrub pa'i las rim gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma dang*// bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i yi dam la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// de nyid sgrub pa'i las rim gsal sgron bri// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i bsti gnas su/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi rten bkram/ mchod gtor rgyas par bshams/ las gtor cha gsum rol mo rnams tshogs par byas la/ las byed pas phyag gsum 'tshal la gtor ma gong ma rnams la zur sngos mdzad nas/ skabs su bab tsa gtor chung gi byin rlabs kyang mdzad par zhu zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub pa pos mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal gdab la/ bdag gzhan khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug ma tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

/nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' ste bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems aṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang po che'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/

'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shapad āḥhūm̐/ nang gtor byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems aṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang po che'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ ces mdun gyi nam mkhar gtor 'gron spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru/ rat+na/ bud+dha/ dharma/ saṅgha/ bo dhi sa twa i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bka' brgyud bla ma/ sgrub brgyud bla ma/ gu ru zhi drag rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma/ gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma/ mkhan brgyud/ slob brgyud/ bde dgyes brgyud pa/ chos skyong brgyud pa/ nā ro brgyud pa/ ni gu brgyud pa/ bsnyen bsgrub rgyud pa/ sbyor drug brgyud pa/ rdzogs chen brgyud pa/ zhi byed brgyud pa/ gcod yul brgyud pa/ dmar khrid brgyud pa/ mos gus brgyud pa/ lnga ldan brgyud pa/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ā d+yā nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ ma hā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ gshed dmar/ dgra nag 'jigs byed/ tshe dpag med/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing tshim nas/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi rgyud la bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin khyad can skye ba dang*/

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol lo/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ka wu wa ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ka wu wa wa pa sha ya mahā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa yab yum/ phyag drug pa yab yum/ gter gyi mgon po yab yum/ sku yi mgon po yab yum/ gsung gi mgon po yab yum/ thugs kyi mgon po yab yum/ yon tan gyi mgon po yab yum/ phrin las kyi mgon po yam yum/ bya khyung nag po/ yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ka nag mo/ e ka dzā ti/ dmar mo rtsa 'jib/ srog bdag bya rog gdong*/ tshe bdag bya rog gdong*/ 'chi bdag bya rog gdong*/ gnod sbyin bya rog gdong*/ phyag brnyan seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad/ mkha' 'gro ma drug beng chen lcam dral/ lha dmag 'bum/ yang 'khor nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gang po mdzes ma/ gnod sbyin khri/ pho nya sde brgyad/ bya dang gcan gzan 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i gtor ma bzhes/ maṃ sa ri ltar brtsigs pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ tsit+ta rgyan ltar btsugs pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ ba su 'phan ltar 'phyar ba'i gtor ma bzhes/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing tshim nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams bsrung zhing skyob pa dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i phrin las mdzod cig bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma tā re ma ma 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki nī/

ma ma 'dus bha dzaṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bye ba'i tshogs la 'bul lo// skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūṃ/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha mes rgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyen po'i srung ma/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen rnam lnga bstsal du gsol/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭa ye/ bi rū bha kā ye/ bi rū bhak+ṣā ye/ bai shra ba ṇā ye/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ༈ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// las gtor gsum la dmigs te/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ sa bdag sa'i lha mo bstan mas gtso byas pa'i stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/

smad mdo khams sgang drug srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ mtsho ma pham/ gangs ti se/ tsā ri tsā gong*/ la phyi chu bar/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' dbus/ stong gsum 'dzam bu gling na gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po/ bar lha lha dang bcas pa/ sog ra btsan dang bcas pa/ chu 'phan klu dang bcas pa/ ti sgro sman dang bcas pa/ tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po/ sa ri sa skor yul ri yul skor/ sa phyogs 'di kun la gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ nag po chen po mchod cing sgrub pa la/ ru nga dang phrag dog ma mdzad par gnas 'gron gyi dam tshig gnyan po srungs/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig

bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pas te// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// he ru ka'i zhal nas khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go zhes gsungs shing*/ he ru ka rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi lus shel sgong bzhin du dag cing lhar gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin las 'od 'phros lus gang 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar til gyi gang bu lta bur gang ba bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud/ ༈ /yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab// bkra shis sna tshogs 'o ma'i chu rgyun 'di// rgyal ba'i zhal la zhal bsil 'di 'bul bas// 'gro kun bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /spos dang tsan dan la sogs sbyar ba yi// las kun byed pa'i chu gtsang dwangs ma 'di// rgyal ba'i zhabs la zhabs bsil 'di 'bul bas// 'gro kun blo bur dri ma dag gyur cig /chu skyes thang skyes yid las byung ba yi// byang chub yan lag mdzes pa'i me tog 'di// sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul// 'gro kun 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /lhan cig skyes dang yongs su sbyar ba yi// rab tu tshim ldan bdug spos dam pa 'di// tshul khrims rang bzhin rgyal ba'i shangs la 'bul// 'gro kun dal 'byor yon tan rdzogs par shog

/gsal zhing mi g.yo mdzes par snang ba yi// mi shes mun sel dpal gyi sgron me 'di// bzod pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul// 'gro kun mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs par shog /gur gum ga bur tsan dan la sogs dri// rnam mang dri zhim bdug spos dam pa 'di// brtson 'grus rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul// 'gro kun yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i zhal zas mchog /phun tshogs yon tan 'byung ba bdud rtsi'i rigs// bsam gtan rang bzhin rgyal ba'i ljags la 'bul// 'gro kun ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /yan lag lnga ldan sil snyan rol mo 'di// shes rab rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul// bsod nams des ni zag med chos rnams kun// 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la 'char bar shog /dbang po tshim byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// phun sum tshogs pa mchog gi longs spyod rnams// thabs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// 'gro kun zag med phung po lnga thob shog /zhing skyes sngags skyes rang bzhin lhan cig skyes// yid las byung ba sprul pa lha mo'i tshogs// stobs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gzugs la 'bul// 'gro ba kun gyi bde mchog thob par shog /rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus dge ba'i tshogs// dang ba'i yid kyis gus shing gsol ba 'di// smon lam rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul// 'gro kun sangs rgyas yon tan thob par shog /zab cing spros bral 'dus ma byas pa la// yang dag par ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i don// ye shes rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul// 'gro ba kun gyis chos nyid rtogs par shog /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs dbang gis kun nas bslangs gyur pa'i// lus ngag yid kyis mi dge ci bgyis pa// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags// rgyal ba'i phrin las rmad du byung ba dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom dang*// so skye dge dang dge gzhan ci mchis pa// ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rang*// 'gro kun smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyir// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems la// zab cing rgya che chos kyi 'khor lo mchog

/rgyun mi 'chad par bskor bar bskul ma 'debs// sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar du ni// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs nas kyang*// gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad par// thal sbyar gus pa mchog gis gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// log pa'i bsam pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// nyon mongs rnam rtog tshogs rnams zhi nas kyang*// dkar po'i yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /bla ma bsten cing dkon mchog mchod pa dang*// mos gus ltem rkyang nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// theg mchog lam gyi sgrub pa byed pa la// skad cig tsam yang le lo med par shog /bsdu ba bzhi dang zhi sogs las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par byed pa dang*// sems can kun gyi bsam pa'i don rnams kun// de dag ma lus bdag gis 'grub par shog /'gro ba'i don la g.yel ba med pa dang*// lus dang longs spyod dngos po thams cad la// 'dzin chags ser sna nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// zad mi shes pa kun la gtong bar shog /dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams byang gyur te// bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro kun bla med byang chub myur thob shog/ ༈ //tshogs zhing rnams 'od tu zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med cing*/ kun rdzob btags pa tsam gyi sgyu ma lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du zhu ba rang la thim zhing*/ rang gi lus kyang stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig ū ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da shin tu phra ba'ang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad rab tu gnas pa med pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa lta bu'i 'od gsal du gyur/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus te/ stong pa nyid las langs nas rang gi rlung sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du sgreng ba shin tu phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chen por gyur/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa/ suṃ las ri rab rin po che/ sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba ge sar dang ldan pa'o// sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang*/ a a/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ brjod/ dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ

ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dang bcas te gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag cig g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang*/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dang bcas te/ gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag cig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la/ dbyangs gsal rnams gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang*/ zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i kā li dang*/ zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can mthong ba nas/ bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbus su skye ba blangs la/ sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ de las ha'i lus/ de las ū grub pa'i tshul gyis dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i hūm̐ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ yig de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ bsdu ba'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad he ru ka yab yum lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs pas sngon du 'gro ba zhu bas/ hūm̐ yig nā da la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ yig lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ zla ba dbyangs gsal sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de yang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lngas bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang*/

drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba'i rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo du mas mchod rdzas thogs nas bskor ba/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis nye bar btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ lha brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ me brgyad/ chu brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre srin po/ sha za ro langs/ lce spyang la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang*/ 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yab yum/ yab sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa dang bcas pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas/ dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan cing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo brdzis pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon gyi cha la zla ba phyed pa bsil ba'i 'od dang ldan pas brgyan pa/ mtshog ma'i steng du rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas mtshan pa/

rdo rje'i thag pa la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga/ rin po che'i rtse phran gyis brgyan pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ sum khug tu 'khyog cing gyes la rnam par bkra ba'i dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ rus chen gyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub skor/ ske rags/ thal chen gyis brgyan te/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa se ral khar thogs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung*/ rgod dang gshe dang rngam pa dang*// snying rje zhi ba ngo mtshar che// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid/ de'i spang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog me tog bhan+dhu dzi wa ka'i mdog ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur sdigs pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum ma skra grol ba/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal gyi ngur sgra sgrog pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyang zhing*/ g.yas yab kyi rked la 'khril ba/ gzhon zhing mdzes pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can sha rgyas pa/ nu ma 'bur ba/ bha ga rgyas pa/ gnyis med kyi sbyor ba la brtson zhing zag med kyi bde ba rgyas pa ste/ snang ba dang*/ thabs dang*/ lhag mthong dang*/ snying rje chen po'i ngo bo/ yab he ru ka'i phung po lnga rigs lnga/ stong pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ zhi gnas dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi skye mched drug sems dpa' drug ste/ kun nas kha sbyor zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du chu khams kyi ngo bo mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du rlung khams kyi ngo bo lā ma ljang khu/

nub tu me khams kyi ngo bo dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor sa khams kyi ngo bo gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing*/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa'i mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhis mtshan pa ste/ rten dang brten pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa dang bral ba bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol du gyur/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs// pheṃ hūm̐ srid zhi mnyam nyid rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings// ma bcos spros bral bde ba chen po'i ngang*// 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog nyams re dga'// 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// srid pa mthar phyin bcom ldan bde mchog ni// mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag gis spras// zhe sdang 'joms mdzad dpa' bo dbyings nas bzhengs// 'dod chags chen mo sku la 'khril ba'i yum// rdo rje phag mo gcer bu khrag 'dzag ma// bde chen mchod pa rtag tu yab la 'bul// yab yum gnyis med thabs dang shes rab rol// 'dod chags 'joms phyir mdog dmar khro mo'i tshul// dga' ba bzhi ldan rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros bskor// ḍā ma ru dang rus rgyan khra la la// byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// pūl+li la sogs mkha' spyod yul brgyad na// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ka ma ru sogs sa steng yul brgyad na// myu gu can dang sa bsrung ma la sogs// gsung gi 'khor lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// pre pur la sogs sa 'og yul brgyad na// stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs la sogs// sku yi 'khor lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'thung spyod la sogs 'dzam gling yul brgyad na// khwa gdong 'ug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong sogs// dam tshig 'khor lo'i bdud 'dul dpa' mo rnams// byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// rdo rje me ri chu brgyad dur khrod brgyad// dur khrod brgyad na phyogs skyong zhing skyong brgyad// klu chen brgyad sogs bkod pa ma lus pa// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyan gyur gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ ༈ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ// me tog bdug spos dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi me tog bdug spos kun// thams cad blo yi blangs nas ni// bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ puṣ+pe dhū paṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+phar ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ /snang gsal dri mchog dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi snang gsal dri mchog kun// thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni// bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ /zhal zas sgra snyan dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi zhal zas sgra snyan kun// thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni// bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa ra nai wi d+yaṃ shapad pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// hūm̐ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i// khrag 'thung dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/de nas dkon mchog spyi la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// 'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// rdo rje slob dpon mig gi 'bras// mtho ris thar pa'i lam ston pa'i// bla ma dge ba'i bshes la 'dud// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal bstod// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron mes rab tu brgyan// 'jig rten gsum na mun sel ba'i// 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas mang pos rab tu bsngags// yon tan mchog gi gter gyur pa// spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba'i// rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po// bdud dgra ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐

sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// u rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// sgra sgyur mang po di ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la// dar zab na bza' pu ru ru// gser gyi gdu bu si li li// sgrub mchog bdag gis spyan 'dren gyi// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// sgrub khang 'di la byin zhig phob// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig bskur// mar me 'di la mdangs cig bskyed// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chod sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ ༈ hūm̐ bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// 'jig rten dbang gyur pad+ma rgyal po ni// rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs// u rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad// bsil ba'i tshal du dngos grub ma lus brnyes// 'jig rten khams su gdug pa can rnams btul// kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen cig pu// sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ /mnyam med bla ma mchog 'di dus 'dir dran// gsang sngags rgyal pos gnas 'dir byin phob la// rkyen ngan bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ sku yi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// lha dbang lus la bskur du gsol// lus skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol// āḥgasung gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// sngags dbang ngag la bskur du gsol// ngag snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol// sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// sku bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshig dbang don mchog rtogs pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim par gyur/

slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ pheṃ pheṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shapad pra tits+tsha swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la mngon bar dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ yab la rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las so so'i dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba skyed par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shapad āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pa badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shapad badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhe badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badz+ra āḥhūm̐/

oṃ spar+she badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharmaḥdhā tu badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tits+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dharma dhā tu pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ oṃ spar+sha badz+ri huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ༈ nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇā pā ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hū?m̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las glad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang po che'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rnams dang mchog gsum kun 'dus pa'i// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i// mtshungs bral bla ma mchog gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa// dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*// til+li pa dang nā ro kar+ṇa ri// rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// rtswa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa// chos rje spyan snga bcu gnyis dbang bsod pa// grags pa shes rab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba// 'dren mchog bla ma blo bzang rin bzang zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos bsod nams bkra shis zhabs// dngos grub rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod/

slar yang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ klu+u sgrub snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ār+ya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a bha yā ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen rga lo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma grags pa seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma dar ma rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma shākya seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku bsod rgyal pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi rje zla ba 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' sdod dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum brjod/ rnam lnga 'dod skor phyag rgya bcas/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan zhing bu ga phaṭ ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru as mtshan zhing*/ bde ba chen po 'dzag pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying kha nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan skyes nyams su myong bar gyur/ lha thams cad bde ba chen po nyams su myong zhing thams cad he ru ka'i cha shas tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med rtags su// sku mdog mthing nag cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs// byang chub sems dang stong nyid dbyer med pa'i// rtag chad 'gro 'ong bral la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i ngang*// bdud rtsi ro yi nges gang tshul ston pa// mchog la phan mdzad rdo rje phag mo dang*// gnyis med rol bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad pa'i tshul// phyag g.yas rdo rjes rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod// g.yon pa dril bus dngos por 'dzin pa spong*// snang stong dbyer med 'khyud la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten spyod grol dbu skra gyen du bcings// ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan// chos nyid thugs chud rdo rje'i thag pas rgyus// yul dang yul can dbyer med khyod la bstod// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan// byang chub myu gu smin mdzad nyi steng du// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// ma rungs tshar gcod mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrib gnyis sreg mdzad me dpung nang na bzhugs// nyon mongs gdungs sel zla ba phyed pas spras// 'phrin las bzhi yis sems can don mdzad phyir// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan la phyag 'tshal bstod// yid bzhin re skong nor bu gtsug na mdzes// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya drug

/mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i skur gsal ba// mi bskyod dbu rgyan can la phyag 'tshal bstod// spang bya spong zhing gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir// stag gi pags pa mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// thugs rjes 'dzum bcas khros la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag 'dra blo dman yon tan med pa yis// lha mchog khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// lha mchog khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /khams bzhi rnam dag mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi// phyogs bzhir gnas nas las bzhi sgrub pa dang*// ye shes bzhi yi rang gzugs mkha' 'gro ma// lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma la 'dud// mtshams bzhir gnas pa'i stobs chen lngas gang ba'i// bum thod bzhi yi mchog gi bde stsol zhing*// ye shes lnga yi rang snang gzhal yas khang*// rten dang brten par bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshogs brgyad dag pas dur khrod chen po brgyad// phyogs skyong zhing skyong shing dang chu rlung sprin// ri dang mchod rten mi ro 'byung po'i tshogs// mi mthun srung skyob bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bstod// gdod nas dag pa bde chen ye shes nyid// lam du lha yi 'khor lor gsal dag bstan// 'bras bu bde chen 'khor lor bdag gyur nas// khams gsum bde ba che la sbyor bar shog /bdag he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te/ bzlas pa byas pas sngags kyi phreng ba rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/ khams gsum gyi sems can lhar gnas pa'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba sems can gyi sna bug g.yon pa nas don// rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gnas pa la thim zhing 'khor ba la dmigs te/
oṃ shrī badz+ra he he

dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī sogs bzlas la/ de nas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ bzhi'i mtha' mar/ rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dus/ rang rang gis sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim zhing 'khor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa kun// dran pa tsam gyis zhi mdzad pa// bla med byang chub mchog la 'god// bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// skye med ngang las thugs rje chen po yis// pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng du// bdud 'dul hūm̐ las khro chen skur sprul pa// bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// dag pa chos sku'i pho brang nas// dmigs pa med pa'i snying brtse yis// gzugs sku sgyu mar ston mdzad pa'i// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing*// ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes ma// gzugs can ma dang lha mo bzhi// 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa'i// mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma// 'od ldan sna chen dpa' bo'i blo// mi thung laṅka'i dbang phyug ma// shing grib ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa bsrung ma dang 'jigs byed che// rlung shugs chang 'thung ljang lha mo// shin tu bzang dang rta sna ma// bya gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'khor shugs khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang*// chang 'tshong go cha rab dpa' mo// stobs chen 'khor los sgyur ma dang*// brtson chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// thod pa'i dum bu keng rus che// keng rus mche gtsigs lha yi sgra// 'od dpag med dang rdo rje'i 'od// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// myu gu can dang ral pa can// dpal chen hūm̐ mdzad rab bzang dang*// rdo rje bzang dang 'jigs byed che// mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod// stobs chen rin chen rdo rje dang*// rta mgrin nam snying he ru kaḥ

/pad+ma gar dbang rnam snang mdzad// rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams srung mdzad pa'i// khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma// de bzhin khyi yi gdong pa can// phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// yid 'phrog gzugs ni gnyis ma ste// bsreg ma dang ni pho nya mo// mche ba gtsigs dang 'joms ma ste// gshin rje bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rje nā ro pas mdzad pa'o// hūm̐ phyag 'tshal bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral ba'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs rab tu 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing*// chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor// zhe sdang rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gis rdo rje las byung char sprin mdog /dga' ba rnam dag drag po'i zhal bzhir ldan// gar gyi nyams dgus gdug pa ma lus 'dul// hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pas sa rnams rdzogs// bcu gnyis phyag gis phyag mtshan sna tshogs bsnams// yul dang yul can rnam rtog sbyong mdzad pa'i// ngo mtshar mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gis nga ros srid gsum skrag mdzad cing*// rngam pa'i nga ros phaṭ ces sgra bsgrogs pa'i// bdud dang bgegs tshogs ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// rnam rtog bgegs 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// spros bral bde chen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /stong nyid 'od gsal dus gsum bde gshegs yum// rnam rtog drwa ba ma lus gcod mdzad pa'i// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi rnam par dag

/dag pa'i zhal bzhi rigs kyi yum bzhir snang*// dran pa nyer bzhag ye shes ngo bo nyid// mkha' 'gro ma tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems kyi rnam rtog blo yi srid pa sbyong*// zhe sdang rnam dag thugs kyi 'khor lor snang*// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// gnas dang nye gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi nga ros sa steng srid pa sbyong*// 'dod chags rnam dag gsung gi 'khor lor snang*// myu gu can dang sa bsrung ma la sogs// zhing dang nye zhing rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku yi rol pas sa 'og srid pa sbyong*// gti mug rnam dag sku yi 'khor lor snang*// stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs la sogs// 'du tshogs gnas na bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yang dag las mtha' 'tsho dang rtsol bas 'dren// bde chen dga' bas mos dang gtso la phyogs// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus srung byed pa'i// sgo bzhi ma mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtson 'grus rnam dag yang dag spong ba bzhi// gshin rje sreg ma la sogs ma mo rnams// phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa sku mdog phyed gzugs zhal// rgyal ba'i yum du bstan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs brgyad ni bstan pa'i snying por snang*// bdag med 'khor lor dur khrod brgyad du byung*// byang chub rten du shing brgyad mngon du gyur// 'jig rten chos brgyad sreg la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces rgyud nas btus pa rtsa ba'i bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/ hūm̐ khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil nas// keng rus 'jigs su rung ba'i khri steng du// bdud 'dul hūm̐ las khro chen skur sprul pa'i// 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal rgyal chen po// sku mdog mthing nag 'od zer 'bar bas gzis// a ta ha yi sgra skad drag po yi// khams gsum zil gnon ma lus dbang du bsdud// ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar ba las// 'jigs byed khro bo'i sprul pa cir yang ston// spyan rtsa dmar po glog stong 'khyug pa las// stong gsum dus gcig 'gengs pa'i ngar dang ldan// rngam pa'i khro gnyer gyen du 'bar ba las// bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba stong gis brgyan// chu rlabs lta bur gyur pa'i zhal gdangs pas// stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad shong ba'i zhal// zhal nas char chen rba klong 'khrug pa'i rngam// shangs nas rdo rje 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra sgrog phaṭ phaṭ thog 'bebs cing*// 'jigs byed khro bo'i sprul pa sprin ltar 'khrigs// so dang sen mo ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'jigs byed sprul pa du ma snang ba ni// la la tshangs pa stong las lhag par zhi// la la gshin rje stong las rngam par byed// la la dbang phyug stong las 'jigs su rung*// la la khyab 'jug stong las drag par byed// khyod ni za byed chen po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khyod ni khrag 'thung rgyal po rngam pa'i bdag

/gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// bde mchog rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi bar chad thams cad rab zhi nas// 'dod pa'i don rnams phun sum tshogs par mdzod// ces dpa' bo gcig par bstod pa'o/ /hūm̐ ri bo chen po'i lho phyogs su// u rgyan rang byung dur khrod na// ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri// rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung*// chu klung thams cad khrag dang zhag /sa gzhi thams cad keng rus la// sgra skad thams cad hūm̐ dang phaṭ// khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing*// stobs chen thams cad 'joms pa'i sa// yum rdo rje phag mo de na bzhugs// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod pa rab tu 'bul// ma yi sku mdog dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba las// bde chen nyams dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhabs gnyis gar stabs dkyil krung phyed pa las// bdud bzhi thal bar rlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa las// snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhal gnyis rab gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa las// skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// don dam rang bzhin phag zhal nag po las// chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba las// bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yon bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams pa las// rtog med zas la rol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa las// rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba las// sems can bde la 'god pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba las// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ nam mkhar 'phyar ba las// gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// de la mi mgo gsum gyis brgyan pa las// dug gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje 'khor los rab tu brgyan pa las// 'phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dar sna lnga yi ba dan 'phyar ba las// yon tan nub pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gser gyi bum pa rab tu ldir ba las// chos sku yon tan 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ḍā ma ru yi sil sgra sgrog pa las// shes rab snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yu ba drang zhing dkar la ldem pa las// bdud kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyil ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje phyed pa thur du bstan pa las// dgra bgegs g.yul ngo zlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las// gsang sngags rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa las// chos rnams ma lus bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ro yi gdan la dgyes par bzhugs pa las// rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa las// nyon mongs rnam rtog sreg pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gcer bu sku mdog dpal gyi be'u las// 'dod chags bde bar sgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// 'di rnams thams cad ma yi sprul pa ste// khro mo'i gzugs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbang phyug gtso mo khyod la bdag la bstod do// lha mo khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol//

mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bstod pa slob dpon ḍom+bhi he ru kas mdzad pa/ dur khrod dam tshogs gral ma gtogs gzhan du gnyan par gsungs so/ /hūm̐ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde ba'i rang rig ma skyes pa// ji bzhin nyid du rtogs gyur pa'i// gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon pa chags sogs khro mo'i zhal// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// bdag med skye med chos kyi dbyings// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khril// zag med bde ba'i sku nyams ldan// sems can rnams la bde ster ma// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung zhing 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs la gnas// mkha' 'gro ma rnams bsdud mdzad ma// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i tshogs// rnal 'byor ma la mchod par 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// dngos grub gnang phyir bzhes su gsol// zhes bstod/ de nas mdun skyed sgrub pa ni/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srog bzhin du bsrung bar sems bskyed la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i brag ri dpangs mtho zhing zhol mthug pa/ rgya shin tu che ba/ bskal pa 'jigs pa'i me dang rlung gis kyang bshig mi nus pa/

de'i steng du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi chen po'i dbus su/ thod pa skam rlon gyis brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas khang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi khrag zhag gis byugs pa'i brgyan pa'i nang du/ khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar chil chil khol ba 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ raṃ las gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer yangs shing mtho ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ro yi gdan la rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las/ hūm̐ gnyis pa chad de byon pa las/ 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje gri gug gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer mtshon cha'i rnam pa can 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug gis thod khrag thugs khar dkrug pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ 'og ma ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gdengs pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ sku gsus shin tu che ba// spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gyi sgo nas a la la ho gsung ba'i tshul du bzhad pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ khro gnyer smin ma'i dbus su bsdus pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan la rin po che'i rtse phran gyis spras pa/ mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig rgyu ma'i thag pas skra gseb du rgyus pa'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sbrul dkar pos skra bcings/ dmar pos mgul rgyan/ ser pos snyan rgyan/ nag pos phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/

khra bos ske rags/ sbrul sngo ljang se ral khar 'khyud nas phrag gong g.yon pa'i steng du mdud nas mgo bos zhal la cer gyis lta ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis zhabs kyi 'gag yan chod klubs pas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis tsan dan 'khyil ba'i stabs kyis ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud cing*/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ nag po chen po ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i thad kyi smin mtshams kyi nam mkha' la/ lcags kyi bya khyung nag po spyan gsum rdo rje'i bya mchu can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi klu gdug pa can bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi tshogs du mas bskor ba/ gru gsum gyi zur gsum du nyi ma'i gdan la/ las kyi mgon po bka' sdod bya rog gi gdong pa can gsum/ sku mdog nag po spyan gsum rdo rje'i bya mchu can/ gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gru gsum gyi phyi rol g.yas kyi zla gam la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi zla gam nyi ma la lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab brgyad la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du bya rgod gdong can/ byang du khyung gi gdong can/ nub tu khwa ta'i gdong can/ lhor 'ug pa'i gdong can/ shar lhor phag gi gdong can/ lho nub tu khyi'i gdong can/ nub byang du spyang ki'i gdong can/ byang shar du stag gi gdong can/ mkha' 'gro brgyad po 'di dag thams cad kyang*/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad shin tu khro zhing rngam la mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/

spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sbrul dang mi gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod kyi khyams chen po la/ beng chen lcam dral lha dmag 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ yang sprul gyi 'khor nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gang po mdzes ma la sogs gnod sbyin khri/ pho nya sde brgyad/ bya dang gcan zan dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ zhing skyong brgyad/ drag po nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa thams cad kyis gang ba/ sprul pa'i 'khor thams cad sha khrag la dga' zhing snying rje med pa/ gdug pa can thams cad gsod pa'i las la brtson pa/ khro zhing gtum pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ rang rang gi 'khor du mas bskor ba'o// lha tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin dag pa chos kyi dbyings dang*/ 'og min gyi gnas dang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal dang*/ nā len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ bi kra ma shā la'i gtsug khang la sogs pa nas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /hūm̐ rgya gar dbus kyi rdo rje gdan// 'gyur med rgyun tu rtag pa'i gnas// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i sa// rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na// gtsug lag khang chen nā len+d+ra'i// chos skyong srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i// ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan/

khrag 'thung rgyal po'i sprul pa ste// bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nag po chen po mthu stobs can// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor// khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdud// sangs rgyas bstan la sdang byed pa'i// bdud dpung thams cad zil gyis gnon// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ bde gshegs thugs rjes sku sprul pa'i// dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni// rgya mtsho chen po'i lho phyogs nas// gtsug lag khang du spyan 'dren te// chos skyong srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i// ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol// hūm̐khyed la bstod de zhu ba ni// da lta ma dag snyigs ma'i dus// gshegs shing bzhugs par mi 'os kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// sems can bde la 'god pa dang*// sgrub pa po yi re skong phyir// thun mong mchog gi mchod pa rnams// khyed la 'bul gyi bzhes slad du// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// thugs rjes dgongs la myur du byon// hūm̐ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung dang bskal pa'i me// dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas// ma hā kā la bya rog gdong*// nag po chen po gsus po che// rang 'dra nag po stong gis bskor// gsod byed sha za 'bum gyis bskor// khrag 'thung ma mo bye bas bskor// yang sprul bya rog mkha' lding dang*// lce spyang khyi nag sa yas bskor// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag la// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// sngon gyi zhal bzhes dgongs mdzod la// rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir byon/ oṃ ma hā kā la e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha'i chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la lhan skyes yab yum/ 'khor rnams la mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa re res dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur// hūm̐ rak+ta dug sna a mṛ ta// legs par byugs pa'i gzhal yas su// pad nyi zhing chen gdan yangs la// 'khor bcas ci bder bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā lā pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ// hūm̐ ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi zhal bzhes dgongs mdzod la// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma bcag /dkon mchog gsum gyi dam ma 'gal// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs mchog rdo rje 'bar ba yi// 'khor bcas brlag par gdon mi za// oṃ ma hā kā lā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces dam la bzhag /hūm̐ 'o ma chu gtsang sbyar ba yi// yid 'ong mchod yon phyag tu 'bul// tsan+dan bla rtsi sbyar ba yi// zhabs bsil dam pas sku khrus gsol// chu skyes thang skyes dkar dmar gyis// mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul// spang spos rgya spos sha chen spos// dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul// 'bru mar zhun mar la sogs pa'i// gsal byed mar me spyan la 'bul// ga pur dzā ti la sogs pa'i// dri mchog rgya chen thugs la 'bul// nas dang 'bras mchog sbyar ba yis// tshim byed bshos gtsang zhal du 'bul// zangs dung mkhar rnga rnga chen sogs// rol mo dam pa snyan la 'bul// thun mong mchog gi mchod pa rnams// dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ hūm̐ ye shes mgon 'khor bcas la/ gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni// nas dang gro dang til dang 'bras// sran chen la sogs btsos pa'i chan// dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa// kha dog dang ni ros bsgyur zhing*// bzang po drug gi dris bsgyur nas// 'bru sna tshang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul// kham bu ku shu star ka dang*// co le nyo le rgun 'brum sogs// shing thog yid 'ong mchod par 'bul// snum 'khur 'bras 'khur la sogs pa'i// 'khur ba'i bye brag mchod par 'bul// rta sha mi sha khyi sha dang*// ba glang glang chen sha chen lnga// sha bran dpag med 'khor gyis bskor// skam po rlon pa btsos dang bsregs// sha 'khur sbyar ba la sogs pa'i// sgog btsong la sogs spod kyis bran// sha sna tshang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul// nas kyi chang dang gro yi chang*// rgun chang 'bras chang la sogs pa'i// sna tshogs chang gis mchod pa 'bul// dri chen dri chu byang chub sems// go ro tsa na rak+ta lnga// bran du sman sna 'bum gyis skor// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// dngos grub gnang phyir bzhes su gsol// bar chad sel phyir bzhes su gsol// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol// bstan pa srung phyir bzhes su gsol//

de nas tshogs bya ba ni mdun du nang mchod dang tshogs rdzas tshogs par byas la/ nang mchod la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la ngag tu/ dbus su oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ g.yon bskor nas brtsams te/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rnams su gyur/ g.yas skor du thod pa'i kha khyer nas brtsams te/ oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka mthing ga huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ las rta mchog ljang khu rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ lag pa g.yas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha hoḥhrīḥ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ yang dbyangs gsal bzlas nas/ zla nyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa thod pa'i chang la thim/ rnam pa chang*/ ngo bo bdud rtsi/ rang bzhin lha zhu ba/ mtshan nyid bde stong*/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras til+li pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

mkhas mchog nā ro pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam med sgam po pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi rje rin po che mtshan mchog rin chen dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba gcung gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras thog kha ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ waṃ rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slar yang rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ klu sgrub snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ār+ya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a bha yā ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen rga lo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma grags pa seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma dar ma rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma shākya seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku bsod nams rgyam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

chos rje zla ba'i 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru zhi drag bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa yab yum/ phyag drug pa yab yum/ sku'i mgon po yab yum/ gsung gi mgon po yab yum/ thugs kyi mgon po yab yum/ yon tan gyi mgon po/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po yab yum/ beng chen lcam dral/ lha dmag 'bum/ yang 'khor nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ.āḥhūm̐/ a phyi sna nam bza'/ dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ tad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha mes rgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa srung ba'i bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ drag po nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam can rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/

dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bstan pa gtad pa/ 'khor rnam bzhi srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag 'gro drug gi sems can/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po'i lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃḥ mgron rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ tshogs la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐m̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wā na bi d+yā rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi lag pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod la reg pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris/ dbus su oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ hum̐ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu /phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su gyur/ g.yon bskor du bkod/ mthe bong nas brtsams te/ sor mo rnams su/ oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ bo ṣa ṭa he las he ru ka mthing kha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ las rta mchog ljang khu rnams su gyur/ g.yas skor du bkod/ thabs g.yas skor dang*/ shes rab g.yon skor du 'bul/

nang mchod blangs te/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yon chab mtha' yas bla na med pa 'di// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings rnams bkang nas ni// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs dri ma sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā// dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// kha dog dbyibs legs rin chen me tog 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtib gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā// tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā// ye shes sgron me ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od gsal snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī ā lo kaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chus// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i gshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje can gyi bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dril chen sil snyan sgra sgrog tshangs pa'i dbyangs// rnga bo che dang dung sogs sgra snyan te// gsung dbyangs ngag gis bstod de gus 'bul na// sems can rnams la chos sgra sgrog par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ nub phyogs u rgyan ༈ /kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rnal 'byor pa 'dir 'tshogs shing 'khod pa rnams kyi rgyud la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i yon tan gyi gter du gyur pas/ bdag dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs lhun grub rgyun chad med par mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ lag pa'i lha tshogs rnams rang gi spyi gtsug tu thim/ oṃ zhes phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pas lus byin gyis brlabs/ āḥ zhes phyag rgya mgrin par gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pas ngag byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ zhes rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas snying khar sbyar bas yid byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang mas yar ldog nas phyag rgya dang bcas te/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes srung bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da na mchod 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras 'khur dang*// thabs gti mug maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /thig le rkang dang khu ba zhag /tshogs dang rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga yi mchod pa dang*// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /snying zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// pañtsa a mṛ ta yi mchod pa 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu ram la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum ar+ghaṃ mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog /dri zhim sman gyi mchod pa dang*// gzugs sdug sgra snyan 'dod yon sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas 'khor 'das ma lus kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐// brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// sku bde ba chen por 'gyur ba'i rdzas// longs spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'brel gyur cig
