/gnod sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// longs spyad pas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas nyon mongs 'dod chags kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐m̐/ brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// thugs mnyam nyid chos skur 'gyur ba'i rdzas// longs spyad pas sems rgyud ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'brel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug tshogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas// lnga tshogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag cag 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor gyis// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad la// ye shes chen po lnga ldan pa'i// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems mnyam nyid chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du ni// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams sol// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// tshogs phud nang mchod gtor mar bran la/

/hūm̐ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rdo rje phag mo la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ bcom ldan bud+dha he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ bcom ldan badz+ra he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ bcom ldan rat+na he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rin chen mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ bcom ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐

bcom ldan karma he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung ba bskal pa'i me// dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas// chos skyong ma hā kā lā dang*// yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dbang phyug ma// 'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// 'khor nag po stong dang za sha 'bum// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// a phyi chos kyi sgron ma la// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// de nas tshogs bran nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gri h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bi d+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang po che'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gis rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas/ nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha hoḥhrīḥ pheṃ pheṃ gtor 'gron rnams spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar gyur/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/

oṃ dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shapad āḥhūm̐/ brjod/ oṃ gu ru rat+na/ bud+dha/ dharma/ saṅgha/ bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bka' brgyud bla ma/ sgrub brgyud bla ma/ gu ru zhi drag rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma rnams dang*/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rgyal sras til+li pa/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ dbang phyug mi la ras pa/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum mgon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan mnga' mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ waṃ rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rdo rje'i 'chang chen po/ klu sgrub snying po/ ār+ya de wa/ a bha yā ka ra/ sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ grub thob khams pa rgya gar ba/ ston pa bkra shis 'bum/ bla ma grags pa seng ge/ bla ma dar ma rin chen/ bla ma gzhon nu ye shes/ bla ma shākya seng ge bla ma tshul khrims dpal ba/ ston pa ngag dbang grags pa/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla ma bzod pa legs ldan/ chos rje zla ba 'od/ bla ma kun dga' rin chen rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing tshim nas bdag dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang*/

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ gzhan yang mkhan brgyud/ slob brgyud/ bde dgyes brgyud pa/ chos skyong brgyud pa/ a phyi brgyud pa/ nā ro brgyud pa/ ni gu brgyud pa/ bsnyen sgrub brgyud pa/ sbyor drug brgyud pa/ rdzogs chen brgyud pa/ zhi byed brgyud pa/ gcod yul brgyud pa/ dmar khrid brgyud pa/ mos gus brgyud pa/ lnga ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad sol/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad/ che mchog yon tan/ yang dag thugs/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo sbod gtong*/ rig 'dzin slob dpon/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod stod/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad sol/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hroṃ hroṃ/ hraḥhraḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhī ran+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi nī/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ wā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ a kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzauṃṇa dzauṃṇa/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/

i daṃ ba liṃ ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmāḥṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ ma hā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ gshed dmar/ dgra nag 'jigs byed/ tshe dpag med/ pha rgyud ma rgyud/ bya rgyud spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la ga ru ḍa khroṃ hrīḥ oṃ hūm̐ shrī de wī kā lī kā lī ma hā kā lī badz+ra ma hā kā lī hūm̐ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru bh+ya tiṣ+ṭha badho si ki/ ma la rak+ṣa sī swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā lī nī kro ta pa li/ kā la rā trī ṇī tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā la trak+shad dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ.oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

oṃ ghi dha sa ka s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ga ru ḍa sa ka s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hro na da kā ka s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ul+lu ka s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ war+ṇa sum+bha ra s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ war+ṇa shwa na s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si ya ma s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ hro na dha kā ka s+yai hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ nag po chen po bstan pa nyer sgrub cing*// phyi dus 'di dang 'dir ni mchog gsum du// gnod byed rnams ni gal te byung ba na// dam bca' dran mdzod de tshe gdug can 'di// zo zhig zo zhig za zhing za ru chug /sod cig sod cig zung zung chings shig chings// snun cig snun cig sregs shig sregs shig tshos shig tshos shig nyi ma gcig gis brlag par mdzad du gsol/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ sku'i mgon po yab yum/ gsung gi mgon po yab yum/ thugs kyi mgon po yab yum/ yon tan gyi mgon po yab yum/ phrin las kyi mgon po yab yum/ bya khyung nag po/ yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi nag mo/ e ka dzā ti/ dmar mo rtsa 'jib/ srog bdag bya rog gdong*/ tshe bdag bya rog gdong*/ 'chi bdag bya rog gdong*/ gnod sbyin bya rog gdong*/ phyag brnyan seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad/ mkha' 'gro ma drug 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta mtsho ltar skyil ba'i gtor ma bzhes// maṃ sa ri ltar brtsegs pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ tsit+ta rgyan ltar btsugs pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ bā su 'phan ltar phyar ba'i gtor ma bzhes/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing tshim nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams bsrung zhing skyong ba dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen bsam don dang dngos po thams cad chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol lo// gzhan yang sems can la bde skyid 'byung zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang ste/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la e ka dzā ti gu ṇa hṛ da i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān bi nā ya ka i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la du beṃ ni dzaḥgo na ru ṭa rak+ṣa re ma ti i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gter mgon/ phyag drug pa/ beng chen lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdang byed kyi dgra sod/ gnod byed kyi bgegs thul/ chos dang mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma tā re ma ma 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki nī/ ma ma 'dus bha dzaṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hrīḥm ma tsakra swā hā/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūṃ/
gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharmā tā re ar+ghaṃ

nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ a phyi sna nam gza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha mes rgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ nad gnod pa rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mchog thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hā// lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med bar mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

oṃ grub par gyur cig ha ha hūm̐ dang ki li ki li zhes sgrogs 'byung po ro langs tshogs rnams myur bsad nas// sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas sbrel ba'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan zhing zhal du gsol// smin ma ser zhing spyan dmar ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong mdzod// pheṃ pheṃ phaṭ ces sgrogs pas so sor bskyed pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su rab bzhugs nas// rab tu gsal zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas 'jigs pa'i sku rgyan gshin rje dang mtshungs pa// drag shul phyag gis bsad pa rnams kyi mi mgo ma lus bzung nas khrag rgyun 'bab pa gsol// rol pas rol pa sel zhing mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ zhes brjod pa'i skad can ca co sgrog par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ste// gcig pus sna tshogs mnan nas ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad char sprin nag po'i mdog /hriṃ hriṃ shrīṃ zhes sngags kyi gsung can pa tsa pa tsa'i sngags kyis rigs kyi lus can bsreg /sgrub po rnams kyis bgegs rnams myur du sgrol bar mdzod cig zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gsum gyi khong rnams ma lus 'gengs nus shing*// ha ha ḍa ḍa zhes bzhad gang zhig dus kun tu ni shin tu rab tu 'jigs mdzad pa// phyug rnams kyis ni nyin re bzhin du bdud dang bgegs 'joms dri med nye ba chu nye bzhin// dbu skra dang ni sma ra cher ser nye bar spyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyi zhing skyong mdzod// raṃ raṃ raṃ zhes spyan dmar 'khrug cing bsgyur mdzad kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ zhes khros pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyi phyag g.yas ral gris bgegs rnams la ni sgrol mdzad cing*// ru ru ru zhes khrag ni phyag gis bsnams shing zhal du gsol mdzad 'thung ba la dgyes pa// ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ zhes ḍā ma ru can 'di yis 'dul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrungs// kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras zhing nag po'i mchu dang 'dra ba'i sku// tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyis rab g.yo rmad byung 'jig rten 'od kyis snang mdzad pa// kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs// baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes sna tshogs gshin rje ltar 'gro dri ma med pa'i chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen// bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ zhes nus pa'i mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs sha za zhing*// k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ zhes pham par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig gis sel zhing skyong khyod kyi skyongs// kliṃ kliṃ kliṃ zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyi srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang*// paṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba// sngags bdag sngags kyi thugs can thugs kyi sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster// zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol// sgrub pa po'am slob dpon gang zhig dam tshig thos 'dzin blo ldan gus pa dang bcas pas// thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang*// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor pa 'dzin dang gzi brjid rgyas pa mtshungs med ster// sa steng dang ni mtho ris su ni 'di yis bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rtag tu nyams par 'gyur// ho dgongs su gsol lo// dpal rdo rje mgon po nag po chen po/

dpal 'jigs byed chen po/ he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid du gcig pa/ ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa/ mtshan nyid phrin las thogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yang rje/ zhing skyong drag po las kyi bka' nyan gyi ded dpon chen po/ mi pham rdo rje gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor pa bu bzhin du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa srung ba'i las la mthu rtsal che ba/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ming rdo rje drag rtsal can/ rnal 'byor gyi sgra lha chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rnal 'byor pa rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bgyi ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gnas gnyan po'i 'di la bzhugs nas/ bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i bde ba chen po'i lam gyi bar chad dang bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod cig yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sun ma dang 'phrad par mdzod cig de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'gro zhing thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol lo// 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus shing dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med pa bde blag du stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/

bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ pha la pha la/ ma hrīḥsngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis/ ma chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs/ ye shes kyi dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang gis phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma/ bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams la/ ye shes la gsal 'grib mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ khyed rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yon tan gyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phrin las kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod cig yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sun ma dang 'phrad par mdzod cig de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam la mi 'gro zhing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du zhing dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig

'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med pa bde blag tu rtsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ pha la pha la/ de nas tshogs rdo rje slob dpon la phul la/ kyai rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi yo byad 'di// dang ba'i yid kyis 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ zhes thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol la 'bul/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral bas// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de kho na nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ ces tshogs la rol nas pham lhag bsdus/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal chus bran la a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs la/ bh+yoḥ dpal chen tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /sngags las skyes dang zhing las skyes// las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /shar phyogs dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni// glang gi mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ lho phyogs dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni// ma he'i mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥgazhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag

/nub phyogs dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni// chu srin mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /byang phyogs dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag po ni// seng ge'i mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /shar lho dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// ra skyes mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /lho nub dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// mi ro'i mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /nub byang dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*// shwa ba'i mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥgazhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /byang shar dur khrod gnas nyul zhing*/ khyu mchog mgo can la sogs pa// lhag ma sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bh+yoḥ

gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /la la sha yi lhag ma bsdud// sha za so sgra chems se chem// la la khrag gi lhag ma bsdud// khrag 'thung mid pa skyu ru ru// la la chu ser lhag ma 'dag /khrag ldag lce dmar yugs se yug /la la tshogs kyi lhag ma bsdud// rnal 'byor pho mo'i gral rnams nyul// la la gtor ma'i lhag ma bsdud// gtor len lag pa yabs se yab// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ka swā hā/

skabs 'dir bskang yig 'don/ /hūm̐ ma hā kā la mthu bo che// nag po chen po lcam dral tshogs// chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la// gshegs shig bu yi gnas 'dir byon// bu yi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni// g.yag lug nag po mar gyis byugs// dar nag ru mtsho rwa la rgyan// sog par dgra bgegs ling ga skyon// gser skyems bdud rtsis bran pa 'dis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// bya rog gdong can la sogs pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor// zhun chen snang gsal mar me dang*// sha chen spos kyi dud sprin gyis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang*// sgrub pa po la bu bzhin skyong*// dar nag lcags kyi ru mtshon gyis// bya rog gdong can dpon dang g.yog /thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe// myur du byon cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ro langs gcan gzan sna tshogs dang*// bstan srung bka' yi bya ra byed pa rnams// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor g.yar dam bskang du gsol// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bshags pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ lha chen ma hā kā la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// ma hā kā la'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas// ḍā ki'i dam tshig gnyan po bsrung rgyu la// bka' ltar ma gyur gzhung bzhin rngo mi thogs// bsnyen sgrub dus 'das phud dang gtor ma chag /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun// rdo rje srin po'i tshogs la mthol lo bshags// bstan srung mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// lug nag gcan gzan bya rog rgyal mtshan sogs// bka' yi las mkhan rten du ma btsugs te// bya rog gdong can thugs dang ci 'gal ba// bka' srung drag po'i tshogs la mthol lo bshags// dpal chen mchog la grub mchog ltar bzung nas// dus bzhi phud dang nangs nub mchod rgyu la// mchod pa'i 'byor tshogs chung ste sku ma mnyes// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// mi tshig long gtam bar du chod gyur nas// nag po'i srog snying gnad nas ma bskul te// bzlas brjod sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa kun// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// yi dam rtse gcig gzhung bzhin bsgom rgyu la// le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang du chud gyur nas// ting 'dzin rtse gcig ma gsal nag por bskyed// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// dar nag rak+ta bhan+dha dam rdzas sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten la le lor gyur// rten rdzas ma tshogs yan lag dam tshig nyams// nag po 'khor dang bcas la mthol lo bshags// dur khrod gnas na sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// pho nya las byed 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan dag

/nongs gyur gang lags khyed la bzod par gsol// mthol lo mthol lo ye shes lha la mthol// bshags so bshags so srung ma'i tshogs la bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yig brgya brjod// zhes 'di spu gri klad gzer gyi rgyud nas phyung ba'o/ /hūm̐ gang gis bde gshegs spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes// 'jig rten las 'das 'jigs byed chen po'i tshul// bya rog ming can bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung*// dam can dge 'dun skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan nā len+d+ra yi gnas dang sde// stong nyid sgom dang bde mchog rnal 'byor pa// nye bar srung mdzad mgon po bya rog gdong*// bsil ba'i tshal bzhugs mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// slob dpon smod cing bstan la sdang ba dang*// spun la khro smra sems can yongs la 'tshe// ma nyes log lta gang du 'grogs pa rnams// gtum po khyod kyis tshar chod brlag par mdzod// ces pa 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa'o/ /ham̐'u bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas nas// hūm̐ las byung ba'i mgon po char sprin mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas bai ta'i 'bras bu ral gri bsnams// g.yon pa thod pa khrag bcas kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// dbu skra gyen brdzes rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// thod pa rin chen sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs sku la gsol// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// tsan dan 'khyil ba dpa' bo'i stabs kyis bzhugs// zhabs gnyis brdabs pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /sku yi sprul pas khams gsum dbang du bsdud// gsung gi nga ros dam nyams klad pa 'gas// thugs kyi sprul pas rnal 'byor re ba bskong*// las su dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol pa yis// shin tu gtum rngam drag po'i tshogs kyis bskor// bstan pa'i bka' srung nag po chen po la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dang*// mthun pa'i dam rdzas dmar chen gtor mar bcas// spros bral chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa// bstan pa srung phyir gdug pa tshar gcod pa// zab cing rgya che'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi// ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol// bdag gis thog med dus nas bsags sdig gis// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun// dam rdzas ma tshang khas blangs 'das la sogs// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba// shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis su// ye shes spyan can sku la mthol lo bshags// sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par ma gyur tshe// bstan pa srung zhing phrin las sgrub bo zhes// srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas pa// rtsod pa'i dus 'dir sems can mgon skyabs mdzod// mdzad pa rmad du byung la rjes yi rang*// zhing bcu la sogs drag po'i phrin las kyis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ste phongs pa rnams// rmad du byung ba thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// tshar bcad rjes bzung las ngan rgyun bcad de// phan bde rin chen gling du bsgral ba'i phyir// rnam bzhi las kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// khyod ni zhi ba chen por gshegs gyur kyang*// byams pa'i yid kyis 'gro la gzigs nas kyang*// thugs rjes khros shing gar dgu ldan pa'i sku// khrag 'thung spyan sngar dam bcas ma bsnyel bar// bstan pa bsrung zhing 'gro ba bsgral slad du// zhing rdul bskal par mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// de ltar lha mchog dpal ldan khrag 'thung la// bsod nams rgya chen bsags pa'i dge ba des// bstan pa dar zhing yun ring gnas pa dang*// bdag sogs bstan pa 'di la zhugs pa rnams// mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs rnams zhi ba dang*// bde legs thams cad bsam bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs sgrib gnyis kun byang nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnyis thob ste// 'gro kun sdug bsngal rba rlabs drag po las// khrag mtsho 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog

/ dpal ma hā kā la'i bstod pa yan lag bdun pa yi rang zhes bya ba slob dpon rtswa mis mdzad pa'o/ /hūm̐ dpal chen mgon po khrag 'thung rgyal// legs ldan nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭ 'brug sgra sgrog /ljags ni phyogs bcur glog ltar 'khyug /'jigs pa'i gad mo chen po 'byin// keng rus skam rlon khri la bzhugs// shangs kyi 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bka' srung che// dam nyams yongs kyi srog gcod che// rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing che// rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha che// dug gsum nad kyi sman pa che// bdud 'dul rnams kyi dbang phyug che// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ste// lha dmag kun gyi dbugs 'byin pa// nam mkha'i bu mo glog ma sprin// 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes mdzad pa'i// gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi// srung ma chen po mnga' gsol ba'i// sha sna khrag sna snying sna dang*// tshil dang rus pa sna tshogs kyis// 'bru sna kun las byas pa yi// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs// thung la sbom pa'i gsus po che// phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs// dgra bgegs thams cad zil gyis gnon// yang 'khor nag po stong gis bskor// lce spyang mang po 'bros 'ded byed// bya nag mang po gshog pa sdeb// mchu sder brdar zhing dgra sha za// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs// ral gri thod khrag g.yas dang g.yon// yang 'khor sha za 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yoḥ

lha mo dus mtshan re ma ti// e ka dzā ti ral gcig ma// phyag bzhi ma la 'jigs ma ste// phyag g.yas ral gri tri shū la// g.yon pa mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin// ral pa'i phur bu sa la drud// sku mdog nag mo dre'u zhon// yang 'khor ma mo bye bas bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rmi lam ngan sogs zhi ba dang*// lo skag zla skag thams cad bzlog /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ bdud dang bdud kyi tshogs gyur pa'i// sems can ma lus myur du ni// rtsad bcad bsad nas khrag gi rgyun// gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni// rab 'jigs mdog nag gzugs thung po// gsus pa 'phyang zhing dbu skra ser// 'jigs pa'i me dpung nang na bzhugs// gtum chen khros pa'i gad mo ni// ha hūm̐ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog pas// lha dang lha min skrag par byed// 'bros shing 'gyel ba'i mgo bcad nas// zhabs kyis ro mnan drag po'i tshul// ske rags dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// sil sil ḍā ma ru yi sgra// dhi dhi dhu ha'i sngags sgra yis// thog gi nā ra gi ra'i sgra// sgra sgrog snyan dang mi snyan pa'i// gar byed lha dang lha mo yi// tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas ni// dur khrod gnas su rol mdzad pa// thung la sbom pa'i spyan gsum po// me tog ban+dhu ra ltar dmar// bgegs rnams skrag cing dngangs par mdzad// ljags ni drag po'i glog ltar 'khyug /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa yis// ma rungs gdug pa'i sems can gyi// sha rus khrum khrum 'cha' bar byed// lha ba zhag rnams 'jib par byed// phyag rgya lnga dang klu brgyad kyis// rgyan rnams kun gyis legs par brgyan// mi bskyod la sogs bde gshegs rnams// dbu la brgyan zhing sku la 'phro// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*// ske rags dang ni stod g.yogs byas// mi yi rgyu ma'i thag pa la// mi mgo lnga bcu 'phyang ba yi// phreng ba yis ni do shal byas// drag po dang ni 'chi bdag sogs// bzlog par dka' ba'i tshogs rnams kyang*// zhal du gsol mdzad phyag g.yon du// rtse gsum 'dzin cing thod khrag 'thung*// gshin rje'i lce 'dra'i gri gug dang*// ral gri phyag g.yas bsnams nas ni// gdug pa can rnams brlag par mdzad// mi shes sdig pa ring du spong*// mdzes pa'i lha mo gar byed ma// brgyad dang rol pa rje btsun dpal// rdo rje nag po chen po la// sangs rgyas grags pas bskul nas ni// gang gis nyin mtshan 'di bstod pas// sgrub pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang*// sems can ma lus khyed lta bu// sa bcu la ni gnas par mdzod// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes pas// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/rdo rje nag po chen po la rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bstod pa/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad las steng pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba tshig bar bdun mar grags pa byin rlabs che bar yang grags so/ /hūm̐ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma ro yi gdan// zhal gcig phyag bzhi mthing nag 'jigs// dam tshig mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba dang*// dam can rnal 'byor skyong ba'i phyir// rang bzhin gnas nas dus bzhir dgongs// ye shes mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje sku yis byin brlabs pas// lus kyi nyes pa kun spangs nas// mtshan dang dpe byad sku la spras// sku yi mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje gsung gis byin brlabs pas// ngag gi nyes pa kun spangs shing*// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan// gsung gi mgon po phyag mtshal bstod// rdo rje thugs kyis byin brlabs pas// sems rtog nyes pa kun spangs nas// mi rtog ye shes bde ba'i thugs// thugs kyi mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// sgo gsum dri ma kun spangs shing*// yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa po// chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i// yon tan mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du// sna tshogs sprul pa'i sprin 'phros nas// sdang ba 'dul zhing gdug pa 'joms// phrin las mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// ston pa'i lung nod bstan pa srung*// rnal 'byor bka' nyan dam can skyong*// dam nyams sdig can kun sgrol ba'i// chos skyong mgon po phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan srung mgon po nag po la// rkang pa brgyad pas bstod byas pas// dam can mgon po thugs dgyes nas// bdag gi ci 'dod grub par mdzod// bdag dus 'di nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// mgon po khyod la grogs bcol bas// bdag gi ci bsam 'grub par mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*// tshe dang 'byor tshogs rgyas pa dang*// thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang*// dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces pa mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs mgon mar grags pa'o/ /hūm̐ byang shar nags tshal dur khrod chen po na// ma mo rab 'bar gcer bu'i dkyil 'khor nas// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs kyi sprul pa ma hā kā la ni// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// stobs chen rab 'bar 'gying ba'i cha byad can// khro gnyer rab 'jigs mthing nag brjid pa'i zhal// dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum me 'od 'phro// shangs nas rlung byung 'jig rten g.yo bar byed// rab tu 'jigs pa'i ljags las hūm̐ sgra 'khyil// rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshems bsgrad mche ba gtsigs// bar nas rdo rje khrag gi ser chen 'bebs// smin ma ag tshom bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// drag po'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil// thod skam lngas brgyan mi bskyod dbu la bzhugs// sgeg pa'i nyams ldan dar gyi cod pan spur// mgul gyi bum pa gsang ba'i shu glu len// rdo rje drag po'i glu sgra di ri ri// ro stod seng ge'i ro stod 'gying ba la// dpa' gtum chen po'i khyad par rab tu 'phags// thugs kyi dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil pa las// phyi nang gsang ba chos kyi char chen 'bebs// thugs rje'i nyi 'od sems can yongs la khyab// gsus pa ka ma ru yi snying po ltar// 'khyil zhing brjid pas khams gsum yangs par shong*// lte ba zab cing g.yas su 'khyil ba las// ut+pal sngon po'i dri bsung ngad dang ldan// lha dmag 'bum gyi rdzong yang de na 'cha'// rked pa gzhu yi 'chang gzung ltar 'gril zhing*// gzhan gyis mi thub dbang phyug sra mkhregs can// brla gnyis rab brtan glang chen zung 'grogs 'dra// khyad par 'phags pa'i dbang phyug stobs po che// gsang ba'i sbu gu ma nyams sbubs su nub// cung zad mthong bas 'khor ba'i khri mun sel// ri dwags rgyal po lta bu'i byin pa ni// ba spur bcas shing drang srong kun+da mo// zhabs kyi sen mo sba dang smyug ma 'dra// drang la mnyen zhing 'dril ba'i lhun dang bcas// phyag gi sen mo kaṃ ka'i bya mchu 'dra// dmar la 'gril zhing rno bas dgra bgegs sgrol// ba spu seng ge'i spu ltar skyes pa la// rtsa ba gcig tu skyes shing gyen du 'khyil// thal bas lus byugs khrag gi thig les brgyan// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya drug

/'khor ba'i nyes pa 'joms phyir mgo phreng 'phyang*// klu rnams dbang bsdud gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan// rnam rtog spangs pas ro yi gdan la bzhugs// bdud bzhi bsreg phyir me yi 'obs kyis bskor// khams gsum g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags su// stag gi pags pas sku yi rnam phyed dkris/ khyung gi sprul pas nam mkha'i mthar khyab cing*// dkar po lha yi rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad// gri gug rab tu 'bar bas srog rtsa gcod// thod rlon rab tu 'bar bas snying khrag 'thung*// ral gri glog ltar 'khyug pas dgra bgegs sgrol// rtse gsum rab myur lha min g.yul las rgyal// zhags pas the'u rang 'byung po'i rke nas btags// ba su rta yi lcags su bcug nas kyang*// zhabs kyis mgo bo mnan te mgul mi nus// thugs kyi sprul pas tsan dan beng chen bsnams// bdud 'dul tsan dan beng gi beng nang nas// sprul pa'i dmag tshogs mang po byung ba ni// brgyad khri bzhi stong ser po gser khrab can// ba dan nag po mun ltar 'thibs pa thogs// nyi khri chig stong dkar po dngul khrab can// ba dan sngon po rlung ltar 'phyo ba thogs// sum stong lnga brgya dmar po zangs khrab can// ba dan dkar po shel ltar mtsher ba thogs// sum stong drug brgya smug po bse khrab can// ba dan dmar po me ltar 'bar ba thogs// lcags kyi spyang mo 'bum ni sngon la rgyug /glang chen smyon pa 'bum ni phyi nas 'khrol// gser gyi seng ge 'bum ni zur na 'gying*// lcags kyi bya khra 'bum ni klad la lding*// bse yi bya glag 'bum ni mchu sder brdar// dung gi skyes bu 'bum ni mda' gzhu 'gengs// byi ru'i na chung 'bum ni g.yab mo 'debs// lcags kyi mon pa 'bum ni tho ba gdengs// khro chu khro mo 'bum ni ral gri 'phyar// rdo yi byi ba 'bum ni sa gzhi slog /lcags kyi phag rgod 'bum ni ngur sgra sgrog

/sha za ma mo bya rog 'ug pa'i tshogs// gcan zan mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor// lha klu sde brgyad la sogs bran du 'khol// de ltar 'dus pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad kyang*// la las mi zad rdo rje'i 'khor lo 'phen// la las ral gri dgra s+t+wa gtun shing 'phen// la las rtse gsum mda' dang mdung thung 'phen// la las gri gug me dang ri rab 'phen// stobs kyang che zhing dpung yang rab tu che// stobs chen gzhan gyis mi thub thub par dka'// dpal ldan mgon po nag po mthu chen khyod// dkon mchog gtsug lag khang ni bsrung slad du// dus ngan gdug pa'i dmag tshogs 'dul bar mdzad// bdag gis yun du nag po khyod bsten nas// rtag tu phyag 'tshal mchod pa rab tu 'bul// thugs rjes zung la brtse ba'i zhing du dgongs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug phu nas g.yab 'dor na// chos skyong mda' na bzhugs kyang spyan ma brtul// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mda' nas kus 'debs na// chos skyong phu na bzhugs kyang snyan ma sra// bdag gi re 'dod bcol ba'i phrin las rnams// nag po lha mchog khyod kyis grub par mdzod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces pa mgon po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa slob dpon ār+ya de bas mdzad pa'/ོ // hūm̐ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i nag po che// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// gdug pa zil gnon me dpung nang*// mthu chen khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ bya rog ming can nag po che// zhal gcig phyag bzhi khro bo'i gzugs// zhabs gnyis gyad kyi stabs kyis bzhugs// stobs chen khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ cha lugs 'chang ba'i nag po che// sbrul dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// stag lpags sham thabs sku la gsol// dpa' bo khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ phrin las mdzad pa'i nag po che// 'bras bu thod khrag zhal du gsol// gdug pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams// gsod byed khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ gzi mdangs ldan pa'i nag po che// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes// ag tshom sma ra me ltar 'bar// brjid pa khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ snying rje'i khros pa'i nag po che// spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer can// gtum chen khyod la bdag bstod do/ hūm̐ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can nag po che// zhal gdangs rngam la mche ba gtsigs// ljags 'dril nga ro hūm̐ sgra sgrog /za byed khyod la bdag bstod do/ hūm̐ byang chub sems ldan nag po che// sangs rgyas spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ dam las ma 'da' nag po che// dam tshig srungs shig nag po che// rnal 'byor skyongs shig nag po che// bka' bzhin sgrubs shig nag po che// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas khyod kyis bslus// khyod ni nyams par gyur ta re// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces pa ni rje phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'o/ bh+yoḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dug rlangs sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas su// gdug pa'i bu mo mi bzad khro tshul can// thugs yum dmar mo srog la las byed ma// dmar mo rtsa 'jib khrag 'thung rkang ldag ma// zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi ma ste// spyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer zlog

/zhal gdangs rngam la mche ba gtsigs// dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug can// ral pa'i cod pan re re la// 'ja' tshon sna lnga kyi li li// phyag g.yas gcod byed ral gri bsnams// 'og ma tri shul dgra la sdig /g.yon gyi dang po mda' gzhu bsnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la gzer// 'og ma mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa// zhal du gsol zhing phyogs bcur 'thor// shin tu rid cing keng rus lus// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// thod rlon phreng ba'i do shal can// gcer bu skra grol 'gying bag can// gcan gzan gdug pa'i sham thabs can// sku la gdug pa'i 'od zer 'phro// mkha' 'gro stong gi dbus na bzhugs// ro langs 'bum gyi klong na 'gying*// ma mo bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// lce spyang rkan sdeb mang po 'du ru ru// bzhad dang kaṃ ka mang po spungs se spung*// bya rog khwa ta mang po thibs se thib// mon mo glu len mang po skyu ru ru// bal mo gar byed mang po longs se long*// sman mo bro brdung mang po khrigs se khrig /skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag gis mngags pa'i tshe// ma gcig glog 'gyu tsam gyis gnas 'dir byon// bka' las 'gal ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di// snying khrag 'jib la ma yi zhal du gsol// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces dug rlangs khol ma'i rgyud nas bstod pa'o/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po chen po yi// yum chen lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kaḥ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma// phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug bsnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i skye rgyud gcod// gnyis pas tri shūl rtse gsum 'dzin// dug gsum rtsad gcod khams gsum 'dul// g.yon gyi dang po mda' gzhu bsnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la gzer// gnyis pas dgra bo'i mgo bcad nas// de yi khrag la 'dag par mdzad// shin tu skem zhing dbu skra grol// ro yi gdan la 'gying ba ste// nam mkha'i gos can khyod la bstod// khyod kyi bka' sdod pho nya ni// sha za sku mdog dmar mo dang*// ro langs nag mo seng ge'i gdong*// gcer bu 'jigs pa'i stangs stabs can// g.yas pas lcags kyu dbyug tho bsnams// g.yon pas mi rkang sha gri 'dzin// gsod byed sha za 'bum gyis bskor// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐

chos skyong mgon po nag po yi// shar nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// ma mo bya rgod mgo can ma// sku mdog nag mo mun pa'i mdog /ral pa khams nag gyen du 'khyil// g.yas g.yon 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum skra grol gcer bu ma// zangs kyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*// rgod cing rgod cing ro la za// bya rgod mgo can khyod la bstod// byang nas khyung gi mgo can ma// sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /ral pa'i phur bu sa la 'drud// g.yas g.yon 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum skra grol gcer bu ma// bse yi mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*// mchong zhing mchong zhing bgegs la rol// khyung gi mgo can khyod la bstod// nub nas khwa ta'i mgo can ma// sku mdog nag mo dud kha la// ral pa kham nag g.yon du 'khyil// g.yas g.yon 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum skra grol gcer bu ma// shel gyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*// lding zhing lding zhing dgra rnams gsod// khwa ta'i mgo can khyod la bstod// lho nas 'ug pa'i mgo can ma// sku mdog nag mo mthing gi mdog /khrag gi ral pa dmar po gzings// g.yas g.yon 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum skra grol gcer bu ma// lcags kyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*// rgyug cing rgyug cing dam nyams bsgrol// 'ug pa'i mgo can khyod la bstod// khyod kyi sprul pa'i pho nya ni// shar lho mtshams nas phag gdong ma// phag rgod 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed// lho nub mtshams nas khyi gdong ma// bdud khyi 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed// nub byang mtshams nas spyang gdong ma// spyang mo 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed// byang shar mtshams nas stag gdong ma// stag mo 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /chos skyong mgon po nag po la// mkha' 'gro brgyad kyis yongs bskor nas// gar gyi tshul du rol mdzad pa'i// rdo rje nag po khyod la bstod// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// khas blangs bzhin du dam la 'du// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces pa 'di ni bla ma dur khrod pa chen pos n+ya gro ta'i shing drung du zhal gzigs dus rnam dag gis bstod pa'o/ /hūm̐ chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// drag po 'jigs byed chen po'i skur bstan pa// dpal mgon yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngon tshe khrag 'thung chen po'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// srin po'i gzugs 'chang gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// las mgon nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// sna tshogs las mdzad mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// srin mo'i gzugs kyis dgra la dug nad 'bebs// sha za khrag 'thung gtum po rab 'bar ma// 'bar ma bya zhon ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po'i bka' nyan sha za nag po che// ha la rab 'bar zhing bcu kun gyi gshed// mi srun drag po seng ge'i gdong pa can// gsod byed seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// shin tu mi bsrun gdug pa'i drag rtsal can// drag sngags smod pa'i dug mda' phyogs bcur 'phro// gang la dmigs pa'i tshe srog dwangs snyigs 'byed// gza' bdud rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten las la grub pa'i dregs pa can// drag sngags smod pa drag po'i mtshon cha yis// zhing bcu'i srog dbugs 'phral ba'i mthu bo che// las byed dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du grub par mdzod// hūm̐ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi brgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// phyag g.yas gri gug bar pa phreng ba 'dzin// tha ma ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni rtse gsum 'dzin// de bzhin zhags pa yis ni 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du brdzes// dpral bar sin+dhu ra yi thig le byugs// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas gdab brtan// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// shing las byon te gtor ma len mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan phyag drug mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di ni dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'o// hūm̐

yab gcig dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni// phyogs bcur sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bka' srung che// khro rngam 'bar ba'i sku mnga' drag por ston// dkar phyogs rgyas mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do// smug nag zhal bgrad hūm̐ dang phaṭ sgra can// shin tu mi bzad rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po'i 'od zer glog stong 'khyug /gtum po rab khros khyod la bdag bstod do// sku la mthon thi nag po'i 'jol ber gsol// gser ska rin chen mdzes pa rked la bcings// sag chen yu ring khra bo zhabs la gsol// bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad la bdag bstod do// tsan dan beng la lha dmag rdzong bcas nas// ma rungs grong khyer sum rtseg 'jigs par byed// g.yon pa beng zhags phur bus bzlog par byed// dgra bgegs snying la gzer byed bdag bstod do// gdug pa 'byung po gnod byed tshogs rnams la// beng chen gsol zhing klad pa'i rgyas su 'debs// sku la me 'od 'bar ba 'phro ba yis// bdud dpung bsregs par mdzad la bdag bstod do// sngon tshe he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du dgongs mdzod la// rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams kyi dgra bo la// gnag pa'i las 'di khyod kyis mthar phyung shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag la sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par bya ba'i phyir// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs myur du bsgral du gsol// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha gi na// nyi ma lho nub pha gi na// lho nub srin po rgyu ba'i mtshams shed na// srin yul laṅka spu rangs na// dug mtsho nag po me re re// dug mtsho de yi nang shed na// rje yi sku mkhar ldems se ldem// sku mkhar de yi rgyu bzhi ni// shar phyogs mi yi thod pa brtsigs// mi thod gad mo ya la la// lho phyogs rta yi thod pas brtsigs// gyi gling rta skad rtse re re// nub phyogs spre'u'i thod pa brtsigs// 'du mo gnya' skad lhangs se lhang*// byang phyogs lug gi thod pa brtsigs// g.yang mo 'ba' sgra di ri ri// sku mkhar de yi rtse mo na// nad kyi na bun thibs se thib// sku mkhar de yi rtsa ba na// keng rus gar byed logs se log

/sku mkhar de yi zur bzhi na// mi mgo rta mgo hri li li// sku mkhar de yi logs bzhi na// mi khrag rta khrag shams se sham// sku mkhar de yi shar phyogs na// sbrul nag chun po nyi li li// sku mkhar de yi lho phyogs na// dur bya gar stabs lings se ling*// sku mkhar de yi nub phyogs na// lce spyang ngu zug di ri ri// sku mkhar de yi byang phyogs na// srin bya kus 'debs lhangs se lhang*// sku mkhar de yi 'gram bzhi na// chu glang lcags skad tse re re// sku mkhar de yi nang shed na// mi ro 'bum ni khri ru brtsigs// rta ro 'bum ni bcal du bkram// zhing chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ dpal ldan mgon po bzhugs pa ni// sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol// gser ska rin chen rked la bcings// sag chen yu ring zhabs la gsol// dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes// sma ra dmar ser thur du 'phyang*// spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// mche ba rtsang phur bsnol ba 'dra// phyag g.yas tsan dan beng chen bsnams// tsan dan beng gi beng stod nas// lha dmag nyi khri chig stong 'gyed// tsan dan beng gi beng smad nas// bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong 'gyed// g.yon pa lcags phur dku la brten// zhabs gnyis dor stabs tshul du bzhugs// 'khor du srog bdud 'bum gyis bskor// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// sha khrag gtor rlon khu ba chang*// gtor ma snying snar bcas pa 'di// mgon po nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas ni// kha ru lag chug khong pa'i snying phyung la// srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod la shog /ra dang lug dang bong bu gsum// bla rtags yin pas khyer la shog /so dang sen mo lpags pa gsum// phyi rtags yin pas khyer la shog

/mig dang sna dang lce dang gsum// dbang po yin pas khyer la shog /glo ba snying dang mchin pa gsum// don snying yin pas khyer la shog /gnye ma rgyu ma mkhal ma gsum// nang khrol yin pas khyer la shog /brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// shin tu mi bzod gtum chen rngam pa'i sku// dbu skra ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil// spyan gsum 'bar ba'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// sku la smug nag 'bar ba'i ber chen gsol// phyag g.yas be con dmar po bsnams pa yis// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa'i dgra bo la// gsor zhing gsor zhing klad pa'i rgyas su brdeg /mi nad sna dgu dgra la gtong ba'i bdag /lcam dral 'khor bcas thabs kyis da tshur byon// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bh+yoḥ nam mkha' khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma// mkha' la 'phyo ba'i glog ma sprin// sku ni srin mo gshegs pa 'dra// mi lpags stong gi slog pa gsol// zhal ni zla ba tshes pa 'dra// spyan ni rgyu skar shar ba 'dra// tshems ni spu gri gtams pa 'dra// phyag g.yas gser gyi phreng ba bsnams// dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rgyud bskul// g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams// nad kyi rkyal pa 'phyar zhing g.yab// dam nyams dgra la nad yams 'bebs// chibs su rnga mong ga pa bcibs// stong gsum kun tu rgyug 'dur byed// ma bdud rgyal mo gshegs su gsol// dpal gyi lha mo zhes kyang bya// bzhugs ni dkor khang dag na bzhugs// dgra bgegs gang yin srog rtsa drongs// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yoḥ nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi na// nyi ma byang shar pha gi na// byang thang de ni chad ma chod// byang ri de ni gya ma gyu// byang rtsi de ni phyar ma phyur// de 'dra'i thang gi mar zur na// brag dang chu 'thab 'u ru ru/

brag dang chu 'thab mar zur na// mtsho gcig de ni me re re// mu men mthing mtsho'i nang shed na// mthing gur sngon po 'di ri ri// mthing gur sngon po 'dir tsam na// gser gyi tshugs shing hrengs se hreng*// dngul gyi chon thag sprengs se spreng*// dung gi chon phur khra la la// mthing gur de yi nang shed na// rta ro 'bum ni khri ru brtsigs// mi ro 'bum ni bcal du bkram// zhing chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du// dpal ldan lha mo bzhugs pa ni// ma mo yongs kyi klong na 'gying*// gcer bu gdug pa'i gzi mdangs can// gcig pur 'dug pa'i 'gying bag can// e ka dzā ti de na bzhugs// bdud kyi lcam gcig de na bzhugs// gshin rje'i yum gcig de na bzhugs// ma ru lu bh+yo'i 'dzab sgrong zhing*// rak+ta'i rgyun chab sbrengs se sbreng*// rak+ta'i rgyun chab sbrengs tsa na// ma gcig lha mo sku skyod 'tshal// ma gcig lha mo skyod tsam na// chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs// drel rta rkang gsum bcibs tsa na// g.yu mthur sngon mo sprengs se spreng*// gser srab ser po si li li// za 'og dar gdan lhabs se lhab// bse sga smug po wangs se wang*// sbrul nag gong smed khyugs se khyug /dar chen glo nan bcums se bcum// mu men yob chen khro lo lo// ma gcig lha mo sku skyod 'tshal// ma gcig lha mo bskyod tsam na// drel rta'i rna ba g.yas gong na// dar nag cod paṇa spu ru ru// drel rta'i rna ba g.yon gong na// le brgan cod pan spu ru ru// drel skad lan gsum gnam du 'tsher// steng gi lha rnams dbang du bsdud// drel mjug lan gsum bar du g.yug /bar gyi gnyan rnams dbang du bsdud// drel rmig lan gsum sa la brdab// 'og gi klu rnams dbang du bsdud// ban ngan gyi byad kha ma yis bzlog /ban ngan gyi phur kha ma yis bzlog /skye bo'i dal kha ma yis bzlog

/rlung khris bad kan las gyur pa'i// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ma yis bzlog /lo skag zla skag ma yis bzlog /brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yoḥ lha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma// dbang phyug sras mo dkar mo dung skyong ma// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad// lha mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do// bh+yoḥ klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo dpal 'bar ma// gtsug na rin chen bu mo yid 'ong ma// rol pa'i mtsho bdun gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad// klu mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do// bh+yoḥ gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma// gang ba bzang po'i bu mo shing grib ma// nags tshal drwa ba can gyi gtso mo mdzad// gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do// bh+yoḥ bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo dpal 'bar ma// re lde mgo nyag bu mo re ma ti// bdud mkhar rtse dgu gnas kyi gtso mo mdzad// bdud mo dpal 'bar ma la bdag bstod do// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces pa ni rgyud las phyung ba'o/ /hrīḥ dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// nyi shar gangs ltar dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan// gzugs bzang gzi brjid 'od phreng drwa ba 'gyed// lta sdug yid 'ong a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// zhabs 'og bdud bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mnan// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long mdzes pa bsnams// srid gsum gsal mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yon yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// rgyal ba ma lus mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang*// sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod re skong ma// tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// lha min gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// bdud 'joms lha min g.yul ngo bzlog par mdzad// dkar po lha yi chab srid dbugs 'byin ma// phrin las bzhi ldan a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// srid gsum dbang bsdud 'gro ba ma lus skyong*// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa srung bar mdzad// 'gro ba'i bsam pa chos bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// yid bzhin bsam 'grub a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// byang chub thugs kar kun bzang chos kyi sgron// lha mi 'jig rten kun gyis mchod gyur ma// gling bzhi kun tu rgyu ba'i drag mo rgyal// dpal ldan chos kyi sgron mar phyag 'tshal bstod// deng sang bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan// dpal gyi 'bri gung pho brang brtan bzhugs nas// chos mdzad sgrub pa po rnams skyong mdzad ma// bka' srung yang dag a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// bslab gsum rgyan ldan sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// zhing bsam dngos gsum rten cing 'brel par 'byung*// ma nor tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas mchod gyur na// ci 'dod dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyed la mchod cing gsol ba yis// 'gro drug chu bor bying ba'i ma rgan rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du mi gtong zhing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// khyad par chos rje'i bka' srung thugs dam can// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs// zas su dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces pa skyob pa nyid kyis bstod pa'o/ /hūm̐ bzhin bzang dbyings phyug dpal ldan chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar 'gyur med 'gying bag can// 'khor ba'i log lta skems byed 'od mnga' ma// bde chen dga' ster rab dgyes dpa' mo ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi byed 'dzum pa'i sku// phyag g.yas ḍā ru snyan pa kun khyab sgrog /g.yon pa thod nang yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin// sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol cing*// za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' sku la gsol// rin po ches brgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur// chibs su sprin gseb chu rta sngon po bcibs// g.yu mthur sngon po gser srab ser pos brgyan// dar chen glo nan mu men yob chen 'khrol// za 'og dar gdan gser sga'i sga steng du// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo bzhad pa'i tshul// snying rje chen pos pho nya'i cho 'phrul ston// lha min gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// phrin las bzhi ldan spros med ngang tshul can// phun sum tshogs gnas dpal gyi 'bri gung du// longs spyod spel phyir bka' srung kun mdzad ma// bstan pa bsrung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di ni 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa'o// bh+yoḥ rin chen las grub rab gsal gzhal yas su// bdud bgegs ru dra bsnol ba'i khri steng du// hrīḥlas byung ba'i dpal ldan chos kyi sgron// 'gro ba'i gnyen mchog khyod la bdag bstod do// spros bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// brtse ba chen pos 'gro la rab dgongs nas// sna tshogs sprul pas sgyu ma'i gzugs bzung nas// snang srid dbang bsdud khyod la bdag bstod do// khyod kyi rab dkar dwangs pa'i mdangs mchog gis// zla ba'i gzi brjid rnam par 'phrog pa bzhin// 'dzum zhing mdzes pa'i 'gying bag dang ldan pa'i// zhi ba'i las mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do// dus gsum thogs med spyan dang ldan pa'i phyir// gsal dwangs dngul dkar me long g.yas na bsnams// yid bzhin re skong nor bu g.yon na 'dzin// dgos 'dod kun 'grub khyod la bdag bstod do// sku la lhub lhub dar gyi na bza' gsol// dung thod rin chen brgyan gyis dbu la spras// bdud bgegs ru tra 'byung po bran du 'khol// mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo khyod la bdag bstod do// khyad par 'bri gung gtsug lag khang chen du// brtan par bzhugs nas chos mdzad sgrub pa po'i// bsam pa'i don sgrub mi mthun phyogs las skyob// bar chad kun sel khyod la bdag bstod do// ma gcig drag mo'i las la skyod pa'i tshe// rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang chu rta gro sngon bcibs// glog 'gyu tsam gyis stong gsum khyab par nyul// bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do// g.yas pas stong nyid ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pa snying rjes bdud khrag zhal du gsol// mi rkang gling bus ma tshogs dbang du bsdud// ma rungs sgrol mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po gshig pa dang*// bla ma la smod chos 'khor 'joms pa'i dgra// rang bzhin ma rungs gdug pa'i sems ldan pa// ma lus myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i spyan snga ru// brgyud srung dam can skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// sdig can gzugs phung sha khrag gtor ma 'di// gsol lo rol zhig phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces pa 'di ni chos rje dha rma rā dzas mdzad pa'o/ bh+yoḥ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha gi na// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba// mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma// de la brten pa'i lha mo ni// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// 'khor ni 'jig rten sman mo bzhi// mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang ni// mi g.yo blo bzang ma dang bcas// cod pan mgrin bzang ma dang ni// gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang bcas// gtso 'khor thams cad mtshan nyid mthun// sku la dar dkar ras dkar gsol// so so'i phyag mtshan phyag na bsnams// bstan ma bcu gnyis khyod kyi 'khor// rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba rnams// bdag gi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// mchod gtor bzhes la dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol// che btsan mthu yi dngos grub stsol// rje btsun chen po'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs bzhin du dam la 'dus// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// hūm̐ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kun gyi gtso// nye ba'i thung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra// rab 'jigs dur khrod chen por rtag tu rol// ga ya dha ra khyod la bdag bstod do// rgyal bas dbang bskur kun dga' gzhon nu zhes// zhing skyong chen po a mra brtsegs pa'i zhal// sha za khrag 'thung za byed seng ge'i gdong*// srog bdag chen po khyod la bdag bstod do// me rlung dbus na dgra bgegs gdan steng du// dar nag ber gyon rta nag rting dkar bcibs// ru dar nag po dmar gtor nam mkhar 'phyar// sde brgyad dbang bsdud khyod la bdag bstod do// bdud kyi dmag dpon srin po khros pa'i zhal// mthu rtsal drag shul myur mgyogs stobs dang ldan// bstan pa srung dang rnal 'byor skyong la brtson// nag po chen po khyod la bdag bstod do// dbug bral bsnol ma cang shes dmar po'i steng*// dar dmar ber gyon bdud mo seng gdong ma// g.yas g.yon phyag na rtse gsum dgra snying 'dzin// dam nyams srog gcod khyod la bdag bstod do// shin tu mi bsrun bam ro pho mo'i tshogs// tshar gcod phan 'dogs byed pa dregs pa'i 'khor// bka' gnyan bye ba stong phrag 'bum dang bcas// bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod do// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// kyai

sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yi yul// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang chen po na// gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin dag pa'i lha// mnyam nyid rig pa'i lha la bdag bstod do// ston pa chen po shākya thub pa yi// bstan pa srung zhing legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa'i// dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje legs pa ste// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha la bdag bstod do// khyod ni yab yum dmu bdud bshos pa'i sras// sngon las dag pas sangs rgyas chos dang mjal// lha mi kun la dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can// dmu bdud dkar po khyod la bdag bstod do// don dam nges pa'i bden pa ma mthong yang*// skyes mchog khyad par can gyi gang zag gis// dbang bskur ming btags bstan pa'i gnyer gtad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma khyod la bdag bstod do// khyod ni mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che ba yis// sku mdog phyag mtshan gcig tu ma nges kyang*// sngags kyi dam tshig phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams// rdo rje legs pa khyod pa bdag bstod do// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// skyes bu dge bsnyen thugs dam dus la babs// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i las mdzod cig /hūm̐ chos skyong mgon po nag po la// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yis// khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol pa// nag po dur khrod ro langs bdag /mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// bcom ldan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis// khyed la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// nag po mna' zan yongs kyi gshed// mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// dge bsnyen legs ldan nag po che// mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// mthu chen log 'dren bgegs kyi gshed// mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dus gsum sangs rgyas mnga' gsol ba// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dkon mchog gsum gyis mnga' gsol ba// khrims kyi cha lugs gsum dang ldan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// rigs gsum mgon pos mnga' gsol ba// dpral bar khro gnyer gsum dang ldan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// rigs gsum khro bos mnga' gsol ba// zhal gyi mdangs bcad gsum dang ldan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// lha chen brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba// dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'bar// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// lha rnams kun gyis mnga' gsol ba// gso sgra chen po gsum dang ldan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// klu chen brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba// sku dang yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// gza' chen brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba// smin ma glog ltar 'khyug pas gzigs// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// rgyu skar rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// sku smad rme ba'i dbyu gus brgyan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// gnod sbyin rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// dpung pa rin chen 'bar bas brgyan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// nor lha rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// phyag g.yas dang pos shing thog bsnams// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dpa' bo ging gis mnga' gsol ba// phyag g.yas 'og ma ral gri 'dzin// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// ma mo rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// phyag g.yon dang po thod khrag 'dzin// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dbang phyug chen pos mnga' gsol ba// phyag g.yon 'og ma rtse gsum 'dzin// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// u ma de wīs mnga' gsol ba// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'chi bdag gshin rjes mnga' gsol ba// zhal gyi mche ba zur gsum gtsigs// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// zhing skyong rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// nag po bdud kyis mnga' gsol ba// sku mdog mthing nag 'od du 'bar// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// srin po rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba/

khrag zhag 'bar ba'i thig les brgyan// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// khro rgyal rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// gsus khyim che zhing thur du 'phyang*// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// tshe bdag rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// sku yi lte ba zur gsum zab// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// gcan gzan rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs gsol// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// sman mo rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// dril bu g.yer kha'i snyan pa sgrog /chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dur khrod brgyad kyis mnga' gsol ba// bam chen ro yi gdan la bzhugs// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// ri dwags rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// rin chen 'bar ba'i do ker can// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// dmyal ba rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba// spyan nas bskal ba'i me chen 'bar// shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub// zhal nas bskal pa'i chu chen 'brub// mgon po'i thugs dam rgyud bskul lo// ma sring yum gyi thugs dam bskang*// gtsug tor dkar mo sku yi yum// ār+ya pa lo gsung gi yum// rdo rje sgeg mo thugs kyi yum// lam bo tā ra yon tan yum// byi to ta ma las kyi yum// u tsu sma ra 'od kyi yum// kar sha pa ni phrin las yum// kaṃ ka ri ni pho nya mo// ma sring yum gyi thugs dam bskang*// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces dang de nas thun gyi gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gtor ma stegs bu'i khar bsgyur zhing bdud rtsi bran la/ sgrub pa po yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dgug bzhugs legs par byas la/ las la bskul ba ni 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung dang bskal pa'i me// dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas// ma hā kā la bya rog gdong*// hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag po che// thung la sbom pa'i gsus po che// ha ha zhes sgrog 'jigs par byed// dug sbrul gdug pas sku la brgyan// gtum po spyan gsum 'bar ba ste// phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar// dam nyams don snying tshal par 'gas// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin// rdo rje srin po khrag la 'thung*// ral pa kham ser gyen du 'bar// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// rdo rje gnod sbyin dgra la phob// kha nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa// rno la 'khyog pa'i mche ba gtsigs// rtag tu sha dang khrag la dgyes// dgra bo'i srog rtsa 'dren par byed// stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// zhal nas dam nyams mā ra ya// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ sgra sgrog pas// klu gdon nag po 'khor gyis bskor// zhabs gnyis sa la brdabs pa yis// thams cad sgrol zhing rdul du brlag

/khyod kyi sprul pas bar snang gang*// bya rog gdong can phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ so rnon lag pa dmar po yi// mchu ni khrag gis bkus pa ste// lus phyed dag ni zos pa yi// mkhal ma snying dang nang khrol gyis// snyim pa shin tu bkang nas ni// za zhing du ni rgyug pa yi// sha za 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// khyod kyis mi thub gang yang med// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes// bstan la sdang ba phung bar mdzod// stobs chen thugs dam dus la babs// ma g.yel ma g.yel phur bus thob// kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skems// 'ur 'ur chem chem sprin nag 'khrigs// ma rungs 'brug sgra di ri ri// mi bzad glog 'od skems se skem// gnam lcags thog gi bu yug 'tshub// rdo rje me yi ser chen 'bebs// dpral ba'i khyung gis khyung char phob// dam nyams thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bla ma la sdang gsang sngags smod// dam nyams sha zo khrag la 'thung*// nag po chen po dgra la bh+yoḥ /dam nyams sdig can dgra bo 'di// rang gi las byas rang la smin// ma hā kā la phrin las mdzod// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can// dam nyams srog rtsa myur du drongs// bya rog gdong can dus la bab// rol zhig sprul zhig kha raṃ khā hi// dus la babs so sa ma ya// sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs mdzod la// bcol ba'i phrin grub par mdzod// hūm̐ sha za nag po'i dus la babs// yul gyi ming ni rgya gar yul// dur khrod ming ni bsil ba'i tshal// gnas kyi ming ni shing gi drung*// zhing skyong ming ni sha za che// nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong*// hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po ni// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// mgo bo seng ge'i mgo bo la// spyan gsum sdang mig khro tshul blta// lcags kyi nyag ral sngon pos brgyan// rno la 'khyog pa'i mche ba gtsigs// kha nas dug gi me stag 'phro// seng ge'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog

/phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang bsnams// dgra bo'i snying khrag dron mo 'thung*// gcan zan stag gi sham thabs can// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dgra bgegs gnon// dmar nag me yi nang na bzhugs// sha za 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// de yi g.yas dang g.yon gnyis su// 'khor ni dus mtshan srin po ste// dus mtshan spre'u gdong pa can// lus ni gcer bur 'dug pa la// srin po'i khro zhal rngam la 'jigs// lcags mgo nag po skra med pa// mig gnyis gser mig 'khyil ba can// lcags kyi sen mo rno ba yis// sa la btsugs nas spyi 'gro byed// ske la mgo bo'i do shal can// mi lpags rlon pa rked la dkris// rkang pa gyen bstan dmar gtor 'dzin// dgra bo ma btang sho ra re// khyed ni nan tan khros tsa na// zhe nag mun pa chen po 'dra// rlung nag tshub mas mtha' nas bsdud// me dpung chen po'i dkyil nas 'bar// sprin nag na bun steng na 'khrigs// 'jig rten glog dmar 'od kyis khengs// bya nag gshog sgra 'u ru ru// khyi nag 'khang zug di ri ri// sha za 'bum gyi spru+ul pa 'gyed// sha za srin po dmag la 'gyed// sgrol ging mang po pho nyar 'gyed// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bo yi// kha dbugs longs la don snying phyung*// bla tshe rten dang phrol la shog /brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā la sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā la trak+shad dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ/

nye snying*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā la trak+shad dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ ma hā kā la ṇir thuṃ laṃ thuṃ/ ril rbad/ nṛ dzaḥnṛ dzaḥtsit+ta la yaṃ thuṃ ril rbad/ ṇir shag shag dgra bo'i tsit+ta la ya/ ma hā kā la giṅka ra dgra bo'i srog la ya/ snying la ya/ ru ru pa tsa la ya/ ma hā kā lā ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la dgra bo'i snying khrag 'jib 'jib/ chod chod/ srog rtsa chod/ thuṃ ril rbad/ ma hā kā la shaka phye shaka phye/ ma ma traka ru dra/ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭ/ kyai/ dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang*// zhi khro'i lha tshogs gzu dang dpang*// ma tshogs dbang phyug gzu dang dpang*// slob dpon brgyud srung gzu dang dpang*// yul lha gnyan po gzu dang dpang*// steng gi lha yang snyan gson cig /'og gi klu yang snyan gson cig /bar gyi gnyan yang snyan gson cig /de ring lha la mchod pa 'bul// klu dang gnyan la zhu ba byed// de ring bdud kyi lan chags 'jal// de ring dgra la bh+yoḥzor 'phen// dgra bo mi nor srog la ya// sa bdag klu gnyan mthu chen rnams// dbang phyug bdag la snyan gson cig /chang las de ni ngo che med// med pa de ni mi la btsal// gser las de ni rin che med// sra ba de ni brag la rkos// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// mdos kyi de ni lam phye zhig /zor gyi de ni lam phye zhig /gtor ma'i de ni lam phye zhig /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs sdogs cig /lha gnyan che chung zhabs sdogs shig /dma' ba rnams kyang dbu smod cig /sa bdag klu gnyan dbu smod cig /bar snang gnas pa sku zur cig /phyogs skyong rnams kyang sku zur cig /mdos dang gtor ma'i zer 'phros pas// sku la de ni phog go re// rgya la de ni phog pa na// nga yis ma lan ma nyes so// yo gal de ni dgra la rtsis// yang na gnod pa'i bgegs la rgyob// gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog
