/shar gyi phyogs na gnas pa yi// sa bdag klu gnyan mthu chen rnams// dbang phyug bdag la snyan gson cig /gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// mdos dang zor gyi lam phye zhig / ces pa phyogs mtshams kun la sbyor/ de nas sbyor bskur ba ni/ /bh+yoḥ zor byung dang po gang nas byung*// zor byung rgya gar yul nas byung*// rgya gar yul gyi tshu rol na// bal po yul gyi pha rol na// mar yul lung pa'i nang shed na// na byin sngon po'i shing gi skyes// shing gi rtse na dud cig 'thul// shing gi rked na me zhig 'bar// shing gi rtsa bar mtsho zhig 'khyil// shing gi rtse na dud 'thul de// srin po kha rag mgo dgu byung*// srin po kha rag mgo dgu de'i// phyag na dug zor nag po bsnams// dug zor nag po skems se skem// shing gi rked la me 'bar de// srin phrug kha rag mgo dgu byung*// srin phrug kha rag mgo dgu de'i// phyag na me zor dmar po bsnams// me zor dmar po lhabs se lhab// shing gi rtsa na mtsho 'khyil de// srin mo kha rag mgo dgu byung*// srin mo kha rag mgo dgu de'i// phyag na khrag zor dmar po bsnams// khrag zor dmar po kyi li li// dug zor nag po skems se skem// me zor dmar po lhabs se lhab// khrag zor dmar po sha ra ra// phur zor dmar po ta la la// yungs zor dkar po kyi li li// mda' zor dmar po sha ra ra// nga yis ma lan kho yis lan// gzu dang dpang du chos skyong bzhugs// sdig can las ngan dgra bo 'di// dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed// bar du 'dod chags ma yis mngal// tha mar rgyu drug lte bar 'khor// da ni bsgral ba'i dus la bab// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di// zhing gi lo la khrag zor ya// yul gyi mi la khrag zor ya// sdig can las ngan dgra bo 'di// khong pa'i srog la khrag zor ya// sdig can las ngan dgra bo la// khrag zor dmar po lus la rgyob// mda' zor dmar po snying la rgyob// phur zor dmar po dpral du rgyob// yungs zor dmar po pang du rgyob// me zor dmar po khong du bsregs// dgra bo mi nor srog la ya// nga yis ma lan kho yis len// gzu dang dpang du chos skyong bzhugs// zhal lce lha 'dre yongs kyis chod// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya// sdang ba'i dgra bo che ge'i rak+ta rtse ma yi//

de nas gtor skyong bya ba ni// gtor mdos khri thog bton nas/ hūm̐ shar gyi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du dri za 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /hūm̐ lho yi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du grul bum 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /hūm̐ nub kyi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// klu bdud 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /hūm̐ byang gi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// gnod sbyin 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /hūm̐ shar lho'i mtshams kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du me lha 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// me lha'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// hūm̐ lho nub mtshams kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du srin po 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// srin po'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// hūm̐ nub byang mtshams kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du rlung lha 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rlung lha'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// hūm̐ byang shar mtshams kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du 'byung po 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'byung po'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// hūm̐ steng gi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du lha chen 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// lha chen dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// hūm̐

'og gi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong mgon po nag po la// 'khor du sa bdag 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sa bdag dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ chos skyong mgon po nag po yi// shar phyogs bka' sdod dmag dpon ni// dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung*// sku la dngul khrab dkar po gsol// phyag g.yas pi wang rgyud mang bsnams// g.yon pa shel mdung ru dar 'phyar// chibs su ngang pa phrum dmar bcibs// 'khor du dri za 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dri za'i dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur// khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ chos skyong mgon po nag po yi// lho phyogs bka' sdod dmag dpon ni// grul bum rgyal po 'phags skyes po// sku la lcags khrab sngon po gsol// phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri bsnams// g.yon pa lcags mdung ru dar 'phyar// chibs su sngon po sgal nag bcibs// 'khor du grul bum 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// grul bum dmag tshogs dgra la zlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog /bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur// khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ chos skyong mgon po nag po yi// nub phyogs bka' sdod dmag dpon ni// klu dbang rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// sku la zangs khrab dmar po gsol// phyag g.yas sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams// g.yon pa zangs mdung ru dar 'phyar// chibs su 'tshal bu rting dkar bcibs// 'khor du klu bdud 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// klu bdud dmag tshogs dgra la zlog

/bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog /bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur// khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ chos skyong mgon po nag po la// byang phyogs bka' sdod dmag dpon ni// gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos sras// sku la gser khrab ser po gsol// phyag g.yas rin chen be con bsnams// g.yon pa gser mdung ru dar 'phyar// chibs su ser po stag 'dab bcibs// 'khor du gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la zlog /bzlog go dmag chen gtor mas zlog /bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur// khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang badz+ra he ru kaḥ /badz+ra gar gyis bro brdungs pas// bdud ni phye mar brlag pa'i bro// rgyu drug gnas su sgrol ba'i bro// rus pa thal phyer brdungs pa las// rlung nag 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// stam+bha nan te ku ru laṃ/ /hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang rat+na he ru kaḥ /rat+na gar gyis bro brdungs pas// bdud ni phye mar brlag pa'i bro// rgyu drug gnas su sgrol ba'i bro// rus pa thal phyer brdungs pa las// rlung nag 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// stam+bha nan te ku ru laṃ/ /hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// nub phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang pad+ma he ru kaḥ /pad+ma gar gyis bro brdungs pas// bdud ni phye mar brlag pa'i bro// rgyu drug gnas su sgrol ba'i bro// rus pa thal phyer brdungs pa las// rlung nag 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// stam+bha nan te ku ru laṃ// hūm̐

stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang karma he ru kaḥ /karma gar gyis bro brdungs pas// bdud ni phye mar brlag pa'i bro// rgyu drug gnas su sgrol ba'i bro// rus pa thal phyer brdungs pa las// rlung nag 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// stam+bha nan te ku ru laṃ/ /hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// dbus phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang bud+dha he ru kaḥ /bud+dha gar gyis bro brdungs pas// bdud ni phye mar brlag pa'i bro// rgyu drug gnas su sgrol ba'i bro// rus pa thal phyer brdungs pa las// rlung nag 'tshub mas khams gsum gtor// stam+bha nan te ku ru laṃ/ /ya ma bya ba'i dam sri khyod// mnan nam de ni ma mnan na// ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan// bskyur ram de ni ma bskyur na// rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du skyur// bskyon nam de ni ma bskyon na// rlung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la skyon// gtad dam de ni ma gtad na// las kyi gshin rje'i lag tu gtad// bh+yoḥ ya ma bya ba'i dam sri khyod// steng gi phyogs su ma ldang cig /dgra bgegs shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// bh+yoḥ dang po dpal chen he ru ka'i rgya// gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya// drug pa thub pa drug gi rgya// bdun pa sangs rgyas rabs bdun rgya// brgyad pa sems dpa' brgyad kyi rgya// dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya// bcu pa khro bo bcu yi rgya// bcu gcig phan chad mya ngan 'das// ya ma bya ba'i dam sri khyod// steng gi phyogs su ma ldang zhig /dgra bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swa hā/ rjes gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes gtang rag gi mchod pa 'bul// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan he ru ka yi sprul pa mchog /gdug pa kun 'dul gsang ba'i mgon po ni// yab yum zhal sbyor bya rog sprul pa 'gyed// thub pa'i bstan srung phrin las mdzad la bstod// bzod gsol ni/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyon gyur pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// bdag cag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas/ cho ga la lhag chad gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin la thang lhod du gyur pa/ khas len gong du ches pas/ lag len 'og tu chung ba/ cho ga'i gra chag pa/ zur nyams pa/ bzlas brjod ma dag pa/ mchod pa'i 'byor tshogs chung ba la sogs pa/ nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol shing bshags pas byang zhing dag pa dang*/ bdag gi tshe 'di'i rkyen/ phyi ma'i sgrib pa/ sa lam gyi bar chad/ dngos grub kyi gegs su mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ ༈ shis brjod ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen til+li nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// phag mo gru pa rgyal ba 'bri gung pa// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog ༈ /sangs rgyas gtso la yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i// skye dgus bstod cing smon lam sprin tshogs 'dus// go 'phang mchog brnyes bstod pa'i char 'bebs pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/skyob pa'i chos la legs pa'i mchog mnga' ba// shin tu phan dang bde dang nges gsungs pa// 'khor ba rtag bde mya ngan 'das thob pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dge 'dun sde la mthu dpal rmad byung ba// bslab gzhi legs bcas brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bdag ni mgon po chen po'i lam zhugs pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsams pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang*// bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis// bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ ༈ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// mthun pa grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// theg pa mchog la nges par zhugs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgoms zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog rtsol ba'i// bla ma'i bkra shis 'dir ni brgyan gyur cig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral dri med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi deng 'dir stsol// 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam// sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu'i tshogs la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /

de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha skong*// mdo bsngo ba smon lam brjod nas nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud 'od du zhu/ gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu/ lha mo bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi 'od du zhu/ yum la thim/ yum 'od du zhu/ yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu la/ de ha la/ ha khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la thim zhing*/ nā da'ang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ zhes phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pas lus byin gyis brlabs/ āḥ zhes phyag rgya mgrin par gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pas ngag byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ zhes rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya snying khar sbyar bas yid byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes phyag rgya dang 'don pa yar ldog cing bsrung bar bya'o/ oṃ swa sti/ gang zhig lhun grub kha sbyor srid zhi mnyam nyid bde chen longs sku dang*// 'gyur med stong dang snying rjes bskrun pa'i yum chen mkha' klong bdag med chos kyi sku// zung 'jug sku dang sprul pa'i sku can mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi// ngo bo nyid sku bstan pa'i ye shes dkyil 'khor bla med snying po'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal// yon tan phrin las sgrub byed dpal mgon nag po chen po ni// thugs rje'i byin rlabs rmad byung sngon gyi dam bca' brtan pas dus las mi g.yo bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad pa// rnal 'byor rgyud dang ldan zhing dam tshig can gyis bsgrub bskul gsol btab na// mchog dang thun mong la sogs 'dod pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i gnyer gtad ma lus grub par mdzod//

ces bstod cing 'dod don byas nas gra slob rjes 'jug rnams la gdams pa ni/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i grub mtha' chen mo rnams su/ gzhan gyi chos la ma smad/ ma smad pas chos spong gi las su mi 'gro/ gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs/ ma 'brangs pas lam log par mi 'gyur gsungs pas/ rje gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes chen mo'i las rim rnams kyi lugs dang*/ dkon gnyer shākya dpal gyis thugs dam du sgrigs pa'i las rim rnams la gzhi byas/ gzhan gyi lugs kyi las rim dang ma 'dres par byas te/ bde mgon gyi phyag len ma 'chugs pa'i brgyud rim gtsang zhing zam ma chad pa byin chags pa 'di nyid phyi rabs pa las dang po rnams kyi don dang*/ khyad par du yang rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa mi nub cing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ rang re'i sras kyi thu bo bla ma chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho ba sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor chu mo lug gi lo'i yar tshes bzang po la/ 'bri gung 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang chen por/ spyan snga kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig// /maṅgalaṃ//
